title: Bffs Cherry Blossom Celebration
description: Step into the vibrant world of BFFs Cherry Blossom Celebration, the ultimate dress-up game where best friends come together to shine under blooming cherry trees! Pick your favorite crew of BFFs and deck them out in stunning spring outfits—think pastel dresses, floral crowns, and cherry blossom vibes.

title: Grunge Chic Alt Fashion
description:
Step into the edgy world of Grunge Chic Alt Fashion, where style meets attitude. This dress-up game lets you explore the perfect mix of grunge edge and chic sophistication.

From plaid skirts and ripped jeans to oversized jackets, fishnets, and combat boots—you’ll have endless options to design your alternative fashion star. Top it off with smoky makeup, bold lipstick, and layered accessories to complete the vibe.

title: Zoo Anomaly Simulation
description: Experience a zoo mutation crisis like no other. In Zoo Anomaly Simulation, a peaceful zoo has turned into a nightmare filled with mutated animals, and you’re the only one who can stop the chaos! Enter a first-person shooting experience like no other. Explore the eerie zoo environment, grab your weapons, and fight back against giraffes, zebras, elephants, etc.

title: Ninja Wars: Battle Simulator
description: Ninja Wars: Battle Simulator is a 3D strategy battle game where planning is the key to victory. Build your army of Swordsmen, Spearmen, and Archers, analyze enemy formations, and lead your ninja forces to triumph across challenging levels.

title: Duo Family Santa
description: Steve and Alex need to race against each other. The one who holds the Lucky Block wins the game. Hold onto the Lucky Block until the time runs out to win the game. You can earn money by collecting socks and you can also earn money by defeating your friend. You must be very careful; steal the Lucky Block from your friend and keep it until the time is up.

title: Jixora – Jigsaw Solitaire Puzzle
description: Jixora is a relaxing jigsaw solitaire puzzle game where you piece together beautiful artwork. Journey through 100 unique levels with increasing difficulty, or unlock Free Play mode to replay your favorites with custom grid sizes. Race against the clock to earn stars, use strategic power-ups like Hints and Time Freezes, and immerse yourself in a cinematic atmosphere with soothing music.

title: Cat Evolution 2
description:
Tap. Evolve. Dominate the Cat Kingdom!

The cats are back, and this time, they're taking over with the power of your fingertips! In Cat Evolution 2,  evolution goes clicker-style.
Tap your way through generations of quirky cats, unlock bizarre and adorable mutations, evolve to the max.

Get your paws ready and your fingers tapping. Cat Evolution 2 is the ultimate idle cat clicker you didn’t know you needed!

title: Chroma Trek
description:
Dive into the glowing world of Chroma Trek, a vibrant neon platformer where every step is a test of skill and perception. With dazzling visuals and a unique color-switching mechanic, each level feels like a handcrafted puzzle filled with dynamic challenges.

Shift colors to phase through obstacles, stay sharp to dodge traps, and be inspired by motivational messages that guide you along the way. Your goal? Reach the shimmering Finish Crystal and conquer every stage with style.

title: UGC Math Race
description:
Run fast. Think faster!

Solve math problems on the go in this competitive racing game! Choose the correct answer to stay on track, one mistake and you fall. 

Perfect for players who love speed, smarts, and math.

title: 3D Kid Sliding Puzzle
description: We've taken the classic sliding puzzle into a whole new 3D world. Kids will need to slide the scrambled blocks to rearrange them and complete adorable cartoon pictures, such as little animals, vehicles, and fairy-tale characters. The game features vibrant colors and lively 3D models that will immediately capture a child's attention. Not only does it provide hours of fun, but it also helps develop a child's logical thinking, spatial awareness, and problem-solving skills.

title: Princess Dress Up Run
description: Run, collect, and dress up like a true princess. Race around the fantasy track. Collect all kinds of gorgeous princess dresses, shoes and accessories along the way according to the goal. Create the perfect princess look. And watch out for obstacles and traps, such as suddenly broken platforms, flames, etc.

title: Bricks Balls Breaker
description: Dive into Bricks Balls Breaker, an addictive online arcade game where precision and timing are everything. Launch the ball, shatter the bricks, and plan your every move to keep the field clear. Easy to play yet challenging to master, this free game offers hours of fun on both mobile and desktop. Can you clear every level before the bricks reach the bottom?

title: Valentines Hidden Alphawords
description: Valentines Hidden Alphawords is a charming and relaxing Valentine’s Day–themed puzzle game where love meets word discovery. Explore beautifully designed romantic scenes filled with hidden letters waiting to be found. Each completed level reveals a sweet and heartwarming caption that perfectly matches the image. With 30 engaging levels, increasing challenges, and a ticking clock with useful hints, the game keeps players entertained while celebrating the spirit of love.

title: Energy Superman 3D
description: Come to soar through the skies in Energy Superman 3D! This exciting arcade game lets you become a powerful superhero. Your mission is to save the city from monstrous threats. Collect energy orbs,avoid obstacles, and achieve the highest score possible!

title: Live Star Doll Dress Up
description: Discover the makeover world of fashion and fun in Live Star Doll Dress Up Games! Immerse yourself in an interactive magic princess universe! In this dress-up anime simulator, you're in charge. Dress up your doll in trendy outfits. Get creative with makeup and personalize your cute doll!

title: Billiard Diamond Challenge
description: Billiard Diamond Challenge is a fun and free online billiard game for both kids and adults. Your goal is to sink all the balls into the pockets except for the white ball. While playing, you can collect blue diamonds that allow you to unlock a brand new cue. The game offers both level mode and time mode, so you can choose the challenge that suits you best. Get ready to test your skills and have fun at the billiard table!

title: Anomaly Content Record
description: Welcome to Anomaly Content Record, a terrifying horror adventure where your only goal is to escape and survive. You’re a field investigator sent to explore a restricted research facility that went silent overnight.

title: Komaru cat
description:
Take care of Komaru the cat! Pet her, feed her, bathe her, and tuck her in for sleep!
Dress her up in stylish looks! Hats, glasses, collars, new fur colors, and more! Experiment and create your own unique cat!
Play the merge mini-game, compete on the leaderboard, and earn coins!
Watch the best video memes with funny moments from her life!
Complete the daily challenges and come back tomorrow, Komaru will miss you!
Try to unlock all achievements! Come and have fun!

title: Connect Puzzle Image
description: Step into the delightful world of Connect Puzzle Image, a game designed to tease your brain and sharpen your observation skills. Match and connect a variety of funny characters, tasty foods, and interesting objects as you progress through colorful levels. Easy to play yet delightfully challenging, this free online puzzle game offers hours of relaxing entertainment on both mobile and desktop devices.

title: Dog Escape
description: Welcome to Dog Escape, the hide-and-seek puzzle where saving a dog is only the beginning. Guide a lost canine through traps and guards, then bring it home to cuddle, feed, and style! If you adore puppy-care, dress-up, and dog games with heart, this is your new daily ritual. Rescue your puppies now!

title: Slippery Drift Racing
description: Slippery Drift Racing is an adrenaline-pumping racing game where precision and speed go hand in hand. Players can choose between Race and Time Attack modes, tackling five unique and challenging maps. With three difficulty levels—Easy, Normal, and Hard—drivers of all skill levels can enjoy sliding through tight corners, mastering drifts, and racing against the clock or opponents. Perfect for fans of high-speed thrills and skillful maneuvers, every race promises excitement and challenge!

title: MMA Super Fight
description: The crowd is roaring, the spotlight is on you. From rookie to legend — face endless fights, unlock unique fighters and upgrade power, defense, health and regeneration. With every match, the pressure rises. The ring never sleeps and neither can you.

title: Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle
description: Dive into the relaxing world of Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle! Your goal is simple: sort the colored liquids into the flasks until each flask contains only one color. With over 1000 levels and unique modes like Color Fusion, Mystery, and Time Trial, this puzzle game will test your logic and patience. Unlock new themes and achievements as you play!

title: Max Crusher: Crazy Destruction and Car Crashes
description:
Max Crusher: Crazy Destruction and Car Crashes is an exciting game in which the player has to become a real wrecking racer.

There are many unique cars available in the game, each of which has its own characteristics and capabilities. From classic sports cars to massive monster trucks, you will have complete freedom to choose the vehicle for your crazy adventures.

title: Merge Pixel
description:
Attractive characters in dot, pixel style!
Combining the same characters creates a higher level of characters.
Repeat Merge to create a legendary character.

title: Run from Baba Yaga
description:
Run from Baba Yaga is a potentially endless runner in which player has to collect as much treasures as possible and run as long as possible while Baba Yaga is trying to catch up with them.

During the chase, Baba Yaga gradually gets stronger: her movespeed and damage increase.An outstanding result can be achieved if player reaches the last stage of the game by running 400 hexes (hexagonal pieces of path).

title: Tile Fruits
description: In Tile Fruits, embark on a delectable adventure packed with vibrant fruits and captivating challenges! This 2D tile-matching game tests your strategic prowess as you aim to connect three identical fruits to advance through progressively difficult levels. Each match removes the fruits from the board, but beware: having more than seven different types of fruits on the board at once results in a loss.

title: Cat Escape - Hide and Seek
description: Help adorable cats escape detection in this charming stealth puzzle game. Play as a tiny cat navigating through giant household environments, hiding behind objects and solving puzzles to avoid being caught. Use timing, strategy, and quick thinking to find the perfect hiding spots and escape routes.

title: Hero Transform Race
description: Hero Transform Race is an action-packed and fun parkour game that transforms you from an ordinary person into a legendary superhero. Your goal is to reach the end of the track by transforming into the appropriate superhero form for the obstacles you encounter!

title: Squid Game Hunter
description: Step into the thrilling world of Squid Game – a fast-paced game for stealthy and strategic players that takes you on a wild adventure as a hunter with a deadly knife. With multiple Squid games enemies to kill, challenging missions to complete, and rewards to collect, this game will test your skills and keep you on the edge of your seat.

title: Lost Puppy Rescue and Care
description: Welcome to Lost Puppy Rescue and Care. A small pup is lost in the rain, cold and alone. He’s not sure who to trust—but with your care, that starts to change. Gently clean him up, feed him, and help him feel safe again. This calm, story-like game is all about kindness, connection, and giving one little dog a second chance.

title: Speed Run 3d
description: Race through glowing 3D tunnels in a fast, reflex-based runner. Read the patterns, react in a split second, and thread the gaps as speed ramps up. Simple one-touch controls keep the focus on pure flow while crisp neon visuals make every run feel clean and satisfying.

title: Tappy Bird - Avoid the Spikes
description: Tap on the screen to move bird up, avoiding the spikes as the level progresses more spikes appear and the possibility to collect coins increases.

Unlock skins, collect coins, and outsmart enemies in this browser cat game loved worldwide. Want the full mobile experience? Discover more at CatEscapeTheGame.com

description:
Escape & Steal Brainrot: Sahur Hills is a tense survival horror where you roam a fog-covered forest to steal brainrot pages while being hunted by the relentless Sahur entity.
No weapons, no escape-only rising whispers, shifting woods, and the race to survive before the echoes of “TUNG TUNG TUNG SAHUR” close in.

title: Digital Aqua
description:
Digital Aqua is a digital aquarium designed for PC Browser.
Explore the vibrant world of aquariums, where colorful tropical fish and stunning underwater landscapes come to life.
Transform your Monitor into a serene and enchanting aquarium that fills your living room with comfort and wonder.

title: Draw Bridge Puzzle
description: Draw Bridge Puzzle is a creative and exciting puzzle game that combines drawing and rescue gameplay into one addictive experience. You become a bridge designer, using your finger to draw safe paths and complete thrilling rescue missions. Enter the car mode, draw a strong bridge to help a motor cross gaps, broken roads, and dangerous obstacles to reach the goal.

title: Malatang Master Stack Run 3D
description: Ready to feel the hottest and most fun parkour game ever? In Malatang Master Stack Run 3D, you become a street food chef. Keep running through colorful 3D platform tracks and collecting tasty ingredients to build the tallest skewer stack ever. Slide to collect noodles, Chicken thighs, chili, and more as you dash forward.

title: Onet Mahjong Connect
description: Onet Mahjong Connect is an easy and fun puzzle game where players match identical tiles. The goal is to connect two matching tiles. Tiles can be linked if they can be joined using three or fewer straight lines. With many levels to enjoy, the game offers a relaxing and engaging experience — perfect for taking a break and sharpening your mind!

title: Travel With Me: ASMR Edition
description: Prepare to jet-set across the world with Travel With Me: ASMR Edition! Join Lisa, the stylish vlogger, as she explores stunning destinations, allowing you to dress her up in fabulous outfits that match each location perfectly. From the serene temples of Thailand to the desert adventures in Dubai, and the tropical paradise of Maldives, challenge your fashion skills and create unforgettable looks for every occasion.

title: Key Quest
description: Golden Key is a challenging escape game where you must solve a series of puzzles to escape mysterious rooms. Use logic and memory to find useful items, uncover secrets, and solve clever riddles until you discover the Golden Key.

title: Marble Bubble Legend
description: Marble Puzzle Quest is a fun and addictive casual puzzle game where your task is to sort colorful marbles into the correct slots. With each new level, the challenge grows — chains become longer and more colorful, while the space for moves gets tighter. Use logic, plan ahead, and clear the board! Watch out: the marbles fill four slots at the top, and only three of the same color will disappear. Place them incorrectly, and you lose the round.

title: Number Place Travel
description:
Fill the grid with numbers 1–9 so that no same number appears in any row, column, or 3×3 block!
Tap a cell and choose a number to place it.
You can make up to 3 mistakes. Fill in everything correctly to clear the puzzle!

description: Come to lead your squad in Giant Crowd io House Capture, a fun .io strategy adventure game. You will expand your power in the city, occupy more houses and become the winner of the city. Grow your crowd by collecting more followers as you explore the city.

With each new level the challenge grows, requiring you to plan ahead, think strategically and act quickly. Bright cartoon graphics, fun scenarios and increasing difficulty make Catch Thief a perfect choice for fans of logic games who enjoy testing their skills, attention and reaction speed.

title: Snow Ball Racing Mutliplayer
description:
Roll. Race. Win!

Build the biggest snowball you can — then launch it down the slope and watch it fly! The farther it rolls, the more wins you earn. Use wins to unlock new zones, collect pets, and climb the leaderboard.

Fast, satisfying, and endlessly replayable. Snowball Racing is perfect for players who love speed, upgrades, and competition.

Slide the blocks, beat the clock, and master the puzzle jam!

Block Puzzle Slide: Block Jam – Slide, Match, and Clear the Grid!

Get ready to train your brain in the most colorful way possible! In Block Puzzle Slide: Block Jam, your goal is simple but oh-so-addictive—slide the colorful blocks to their matching exits and clear the board before time runs out.

title: Penguin Farm - Ice Merge
description:
Explore a world of frozen islands where penguins run their own farm. Collect resources, merge wood, build and upgrade buildings to open up new territories. Develop your settlement step by step, expand your glaciers, and watch your income grow.
Train your penguins, improve production, and head to the ocean for rewards—there drift chests filled with valuable treasures. Upgrade each building, manage your resources, and turn your small island into a thriving icy farm.

title: Stickman Zombie vs Stickman Hero
description:
Stickman Zombie vs Stickman Hero is a stick war game about zombies, stickman, noob and pro who stole lucky block. The zombie boss is chasing them to bring the lucky block back to the roblox world, but the stickman hero escapes, resurrecting his allies along the way/

title: Romantic Match Tactics
description: Romantic Match Tactics" invites you into a charming world where love meets strategy. Immerse yourself in an enchanting puzzle adventure as you strategically clear the grid, saving moves, and mastering the key to success – a delicate balance between item movement and unlocking the locked items. Progress through 48 levels, each unveiling new challenges as you align romantic trios to triumph.

title: Snake Classic
description: Snake Classic: A modern twist on the nostalgic snake game. Navigate your snake through six unique modes: Classic, Box, Tunnel, Mill, Condo, and Rail. Collect fruits and gems, customize your snake with skins, and enjoy multi-language support. Compete on personal leaderboards and play on both PC and mobile. Fun and engaging for all ages!

title: Robbie: Become a Beast
description:
Transform into a wild animal and train to become the fastest and strongest in "Robbie: Become a Beast"!

title: Epic Car Stunt Race Obby
description: Epic Car Stunt Race Obby is a fast-paced, acrobatic and challenging stunt racing game. In these races with hundreds of different levels, each new track creates a completely different excitement with its special design. You can play Epic Car Stunt Race Obby against AI racers or with your friend in 2 player mode. Start the endless racing excitement now!

title: Dazzling Divas Makeup
description: Test your makeup artist skills in Dazzling Divas Makeup! Inspired by My Little Pony, this colorful dress-up game lets you create magical makeup looks for three fabulous girls—Lila, Mimi, and Roxy. Style each diva with Fluttershy, Pinkie Pie, and Rainbow Dash–inspired makeup, then complete their look with trendy tops and accessories. With endless outfit combos and sparkling vibes, this is the ultimate glam experience for fashion lovers!

title: Build and Run
description: Experience the ultimate blend of running and building in our action-packed game! Navigate through exciting levels by constructing missing parts of the level while running at full speed. Master using horizontal builds, slopes, and ramps to keep moving forward and avoid dangerous traps.

title: Wood Blocks Jam
description:
Wood Blocks Jam is a relaxing logic puzzle game with colorful wooden blocks. Your goal is to drag each block into a gate of the same color. No time limits — just calm, thoughtful gameplay.

Enjoy thousands of handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty and new mechanics to discover.

title: Turbo Stars
description:
Hop on your skateboard and speed down the track in this wild and fast-paced racing game!

Zoom through a wide variety of exhilarating tracks and defeat your opponents!

Think fast to pick up items that will help you gain an advantage — or even pick up and throw your competitors if they get too close to you! 

Don’t forget to snatch coins and keys to unlock a whole bunch of awesome items, including power-ups, new objects to ride on, and gear for your character.

title: Sprunki Torches Maze
description: Light up all the torches in the room to unlock the door. Some torches are linked and will toggle together when activated. Watch out for bats! Contact with them results in a game over! Your goal is to exit the house through the front yard door.

title: Block Blast Jewel Puzzle
description: Block Blast: Jewel Puzzle is a vibrant block-stacking game that mixes calm strategy with thrilling speed. Fit jewel blocks to clear lines in Classic, Timer, or Level modes. Easy to start, tough to master, and super satisfying—compete worldwide and climb the leaderboard!

title: Draw To Crush : Monster Game
description: Play the thrilling "Draw To Crush: Monster game" . Use your artistic talent to defeat evil creatures. sketch and destroy the monster and save animals and the good clown at the same time is your task, you have to draw the line that changes into a three-dimensional weapon to blast the monster.

title: Stickman Punishment
description: When a mysterious radiation blast grants Stickman and his friends superpowers, heartbreak quickly turns into a quest for revenge! Betrayed by his best friend over a girl, Stickman discovers he can morph into any shape imaginable. Now, he’s ready to use his new abilities to create chaos and keep the pair apart. Dive into this action-packed story filled with unique animations, clever payback strategies, and endless creativity!

title: Broomcraft Mystic Evasion
description: Broomcraft Mystic Evasion is an action-packed horde survival game where you soar through the skies on a magical broom, battling waves of enemies! Defeat foes and gather experience points to level up and grow stronger. Unlock and master powerful spells, evolving them to take down enemies even faster. Good luck in your battles!

title: Mafia Roulette
description:
Mafia Roulette
Play against the mafia with 5 lives each. Only one survives.
Use 3 starting cards to:

Deal more damage or block attacks
Draw or steal cards
Change rules mid-game

Bet tokens to test your luck. Each move is critical - risk for rewards or play it safe?
Every round tests strategy, psychology, and chance. Ready to prove you're the ultimate gambler?

title: Penguin Adventure
description: Join the penguin’s adventure in Penguin Adventure! You will play as a penguin who must reach the castle in each level. You will explore three worlds, each with its own challenges and surprises. You will also have to control the penguin’s actions. You will collect stars and hearts along the way, which will affect your score and rewards. You will need enough yellow stars to unlock the next world. Penguin Adventure is a game that will test your reaction and strategy. Don’t miss this fun game!

title: BouncePop Quest
description: Guide Jumpo, a squishy and color-changing jelly creature, through over 150 vibrant levels filled with tricky obstacles, moving platforms, and environmental hazards. Charge and release powerful jumps to collect stars, dodge enemies, and unlock new worlds—from the icy peaks to fiery lava lands. Master timing, aim for achievements, and power up in this cute, bouncy adventure!

title: Zombie Derby Pixel Survival
description: Zombie Derby Pixel Survival has never before been the destruction of zombies so bright, dynamic and fun. Take a new look at the world of the zombie apocalypse. Never before has killing zombies been so vibrant, dynamic and fun.

title: CS: Upgrade Gun
description: The weapon is alive and ready to go hunting! In this fast-paced launcher, you control a cannon that runs itself and shoots at targets. Collect boosters, improve their performance and last as long as possible. The further you go, the more action and explosions!

title: Flag Puzzle Jam: Collect Flags
description: Immerse yourself in Flag Jam, a unique blend of puzzle-solving, flags collecting, and visual ASMR effects! Tap to match banner pieces, watch them glide smoothly into place, and clear the board as you complete each flag. With easy-to-learn mechanics and stunning visual effects, Flag Jam is the perfect game to help you unwind.

title: Running In Foam
description: Welcome to the wonderful world of "Running In Foam"! Everything here is made of soft, colorful foam. You'll play as a cute character, racing through foam-filled tracks. You need to nimbly jump over giant foam obstacles, slide down slippery foam slides, and collect shiny gems to unlock new characters and power-ups. The game is fast-paced with fresh, adorable graphics, and every run is full of surprises and fun. Be careful not to get lost in the foam!

title: Christmas sorting
description:
Christmas Sorting is a relaxing game for all ages. Place objects next to each other to collect 3 identical objects in a row.
Collect all the unique decorations for a Christmas atmosphere.
Create Christmas coziness, decorate the Christmas tree the way you want.

title: Thread Match
description: Immerse yourself in the world of Thread Match — a unique and exciting puzzle where you sort colorful threads to complete embroidery patterns. Unravel layers of palettes, carefully working your way down to reveal hidden threads. Use logic and strategy to avoid running out of moves. But be careful — the color palette can be tricky, and every choice matters!

title: 2 Player Mini Challenge
description: 2 Player Mini Challenge is an online casual game. If you want to play with your friends on the same device, or if you want to play alone against the AI, this is the game for you! This 2-player game collection features beautifully minimalist graphics that allow you to focus on going head-to-head with your opponent. The more participants you have, the more fun you'll have as you practice skills, react quickly, and interact with friends, relatives, and coworkers in a whole new way.

title: House Robber
description: House Robber is a free online game with the theme of a robber for boys. In the game, you will play a robber, sneak into the house and steal all kinds of goods. Be careful to return after you get it, and don't be found by the security guard. Each level has its own scene, so you must be careful in stealing. The whole process is very exciting, are you confident to surpass it? Come and challenge!

title: Candy Battle: Sweet Survivors
description: The city is under attack by dangerous zombies, and you must become a hero to save it! Awakened by a dream, you take on the mantle of a human warrior with unlimited potential, joining other survivors to fight against the evil horde. But with the zombies greatly outnumbering you, any mistake could lead to dire consequences. You must find a way to survive this crisis.

title: Word Rivers
description: Play Word Rivers - an exciting word game where you can enjoy a sea of words and fantastic crosswords. Find words from letters and discover the wonders of the world and words right now!

title: Words or Die
description:
Build words to survive — think fast or get crushed!

In this fast-paced word survival game, players race to create words from random letters. Each correct word builds a tower under your feet. Fail to spell on time? Lava rises, and you're out!

 - Stay above the lava
 - Show off your vocabulary skills
 - Compete against others in real-time
 - Choose your character and style
 - Only the smartest will survive!

title: Stickman Halloween Survive
description:
Now that Halloween is here, the gloomiest day of the year, it's time to bring back the courageous white stickman who is an expert at vanquishing monsters. Stop procrastinating and start enjoying Stickman Halloween Survive right now on your preferred mobile device. It's a fun and free online game. 
Every living thing on Earth is frightened to death when monsters emerge from their underground lairs on Halloween night.

title: Stickman Choosing actions
description: The Stickman character was kidnapped by a creature and locked up in prison. Your task is to escape from prison. Use an item selection or action. What should I choose? Left or right? It's up to you.

title: Stickman Prison and Love
description: In Stickman Prison and Love, help Stickman escape from jail after a daring heist for love! With a mysterious package from his sweetheart, carefully choose your tools to plan his escape. Every decision shapes the twists of this story-driven adventure—can Stickman reunite with his true love?

title: Fishing Baron Real Fishing
description: Fishing Baron Real Fishing is a casual fishing simulator that offers a realistic fishing experience. Enjoy a relaxing and challenging fishing journey. Become a fishing master. Start a fishing adventure across various beautiful fishing locations. From lakes to oceans, you can unlock different areas to fish. Each location has unique fish species and environments.

title: Steampunk Tower Builder
description: Build the tallest tower and touch the sky with the steampunk tower builder! Simply tap to release the blocks, making sure to release them at the right time to balance the tower. The tower will rise higher with each correctly placed block. If a block falls, you’ll have to start over. Use the funds you’ve accumulated to build as high as possible and climb the leaderboard!

title: Block Craft 3d
description: Block Craft 3D is a first-person RPG game with 3D pixel Minecraft models. Starting from a block base, you can attack the monsters outside to claim diamonds with weapons. I strongly suggest you build bombs to destroy terrains or build blocks to make yourself safe. When you earn enough diamonds, you can unlock and use 4 Melee weapons, 11 guns, and 8 bombs in the store. Glad you will have a good time in this block world.

title: Flip It 3D
description: In this fun and challenging puzzle platform game, test your strategic thinking as you navigate through levels where flipping platforms is the key to survival! Goblins and knights have different abilities, and they must be moved carefully across platforms to complete each level. But be careful—characters can only survive a limited number of flips, and platforms can't be flipped if they are occupied!

title: Hidden Objects
description: Hidden Objects is a visually stunning puzzle game that challenges your observation skills. Explore beautifully detailed scenes filled with cleverly hidden items. Use hints if needed, but the real reward lies in uncovering every object on your own. Dive into a world of mystery and sharpen your perception.

You need to draw the correct lines and colors to complete the image given by the customer. Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop are playable. Come and get a new entertainment experience.

Elevate your style with creative manicures, from floral elegance to modern motifs. Immerse yourself in the art of nail fashion and transform your fingertips into a canvas of spring-inspired beauty.

title: Sorcerer Mahjong Marvels
description: Step into the Sorcerer Mahjong Marvels. Match mystical tiles adorned with enchanting artifacts. Collect only open tiles that don't have adjacent tiles to the left or right. Gather all the tile sets to win each level. Conquer 60 levels within the time limits to complete this game. Uncover magical secrets to become the ultimate magician!

title: Fierce Battle Breakout
description:
This is a fast-paced 3D mini-game that combines survival, combat and strategy. Players will play the role of survivors striving for survival. Facing the threats from enemies, the pursuit of hostile forces and the harsh environment, they will embark on a thrilling journey of survival and defense.
The difficulty of the levels will keep increasing. Each level has a large number of enemies constantly swarming towards the players. Players need to eliminate all the enemies to win.

title: Sniper vs Sniper
description: Sniper vs. Sniper is a game where players compete in sniper shooting skills. Each player takes on the role of a sniper, participating in intense battles with an opponent. Exciting long-distance sniper duels where key skills include accuracy, strategy, and quick reaction.

title: Mahjong Tile Club
description: Step into the relaxing world of Mahjong Tile Club, where timeless tile-matching meets innovative gameplay! This solitaire-style mahjong game is perfect for anyone looking for a calm yet engaging puzzle experience. With simple rules and soothing gameplay, it’s easy to pick up and hard to put down. Match identical tiles, clear the board, and enjoy a satisfying sense of accomplishment.

title: Spring Tile Master
description: Welcome to Spring Tile Master! Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of spring as you match tiles adorned with blooming flowers, colorful leaves, and charming insects. Draw tiles from the board to form sets of three. Keep up to 9 tiles in your stack and shuffle when needed. Collect all tiles to unlock new levels. Enjoy the enchanting springtime adventure and become the ultimate Spring Tile Master!

title: Gun Match Screw
description: a unique level-based puzzle game that combines screw puzzles with exciting gun-themed mechanics. In this game, each level presents you with a board shaped like different guns or gun parts, and your goal is to unlock all the boards by matching colored screws, which are represented as bullets.

title: Jump Dash
description:
Leap, soar, and survive in this fast-paced rhythm platformer!
Step into the intense world of Jump Dash, where every move must be perfectly timed. Test your reflexes as you jump, glide, and flip through treacherous levels packed with spikes, traps, and relentless obstacles.

title: Beggar Clicker
description: Beggar Clicker is a casual game. It is unimaginable that a beggar living on the street can make money so quickly. A few thousand dollars in just one minute. Just tap the screen to generate a steady stream of money. Enjoy!

title: Dog Merge Mania
description: Merge cute puppies! Unlock breeds & grow your own fluffy dog paradise! A Relaxing Escape: The perfect mix of chill gameplay and light strategy.

title: Rescue Hero
description: The hero begins his journey for treasure and save princess, but the puzzles in front of the hunter trapped him. What you need to do is to pull the pins in the right order, so that the hero can take the hidden treasure and save princess away from dragon, wolf and monster safely.

title: Real GT Racing Simulator
description: "Real GT Racing Simulator" offers the ultimate driving experience for racing enthusiasts. Get behind the wheel of meticulously detailed cars and race on stunningly realistic tracks. Compete in high-speed circuits, fine-tune your vehicle for peak performance, and rise through the ranks to become a true racing legend. This game emphasizes authentic driving physics, customizable cars, and a variety of racing modes—from casual races to full championship tournaments.

title: Mojicon Winter Connect
description:
The Mojicon series returns for the holidays! Match festive tiles, break the new Ice Sheet blockers, and enjoy a relaxing winter puzzle adventure. ❄️
Mojicon Winter Connect takes the classic Onet matching fun you love and covers it in a layer of fresh snow. Immerse yourself in a cozy holiday atmosphere, connecting festive icons like reindeer, gingerbread men, and happy snowmen.
Fast, satisfying, and full of seasonal charm – it’s the perfect winter puzzle for all ages. ✨✨✨

title: Shape-Shifting
description: Choose different vehicles to adapt to various terrains, allowing yourself to navigate through the terrain faster and become the first in the race.

title: Hexa GO!
description: A puzzle game about dropping hexagons from grid. To do this, use a bomb and explode all the tiles nearby! Click on the rotate-button and swap the tiles! And also use other special tiles!

title: Beach Club
description:
Calm down and manage your Beach Club!
Relax while listening to the waves, the ocean and some gulls. And soon you'll feel like you're floating around at the beach...
Let your helpers do all the work, stroll through the sand and collect the money from your customers.
Unlock new stuff so that even more people will come to your beach :D

Buy more seats, expand your beach and build your own empire!
Get some clean towels and make your Beach Club the most beautiful place.

title: Domino Online Multiplayer
description:
Do you like strategy, excitement and duel battles? You will find different modes, flexible settings and strong opponents.

Variety of modes:
With a computer – hone your skills against AI of varying difficulty
Online Duels - fight with live players in real time
Play with a friend – send a link and play together, even from a distance
On one screen – convenient for pair battles at home

Every game is a challenge, and every move is a step towards victory!

title: Merge Combo
description: Immerse yourself in this captivating merge puzzle game! Combine matching blocks to score points and trigger epic combos. The more blocks you merge, the bigger the numbers and combos grow! Test your strategy and aim for the highest score—how large a number can you create?

title: Barbee Black Friday Fashion
description: Get ready for a fashion-filled shopping day with Barbee Black Friday Fashion, the ultimate dress-up experience for style lovers! Barbee is hitting the mall for the biggest sale of the year, and she needs your expert fashion sense to shine. Explore chic winterwear, cozy sweaters, stylish boots, and dazzling accessories.

title: Cooking Stories: Fun cafe game
description:
Become the host of the popular transformation cooking show — Cooking Stories! You are not just a chef, you are a culinary genius, a style master, and an interior designer. Participants come to you at their most desperate moment: they urgently need help — and only you can change and save their lives!

But that’s not all...  
Take a peek behind the scenes of the TV show: intrigue, emotions, unexpected twists — all this in the game Cooking Stories!

title: Giant Wanted Monster
description: The city is being occupied by giant monsters. You, as an elite sniper, pick up your sniper gun. Defeat these crazy monsters and protect the survival of humanity. In Giant Wanted Monster, the fate of the city is at stake with every bullet. You need to use the powerful sniper weapon to shoot accurately from a distance and hit the monster's Achilles heel.

title: Black Pink St.Patricks day Concert
description: Step into the glamorous world of Black Pink St. Patrick’s Day Concert, the ultimate dress-up game! Style your favorite Black Pink members with trendy outfits, accessories, and makeup to make them shine for their St. Patrick’s Day performance. With simple controls and endless creativity, this game is perfect for quick fun or long gaming sessions.

title: Ocean Rescue
description: A dark power has invaded the ocean, locking sea creatures in water bubbles. Play as Squiddy, a determined and cute squid on a mission to his besties and meet new friends along the way.

title: Bullet - Superhero
description:
Destroy your opponents in an exciting puzzle game! Become a superhero, shoot ricochets at enemies and win! A physical game with ragdoll-style heroes will help you improve your marksmanship skills and solve difficult missions!
A fun 2D game in which a superhero must destroy all his enemies.
It's not that simple, the hero's hand is constantly moving and you'll have to aim well to hit the target!
Shoot a ricochet at the enemy and complete all levels.

title: Pet Salon 2
description: Take care of the cutest puppy and cat that you can bathe, help it when it is sick and choose an outfit  and dress it up! Pet Salon 2 is very helpful for the daycare of your pet and have too much fun with this game.

title: Zombies: Battle for Survival
description: Survive an endless onslaught of zombies! Each wave gets harder, ammo is running low, and hope is fading. Unlock new areas, buy weapons, upgrade gear, and build barricades to slow the undead. Can you endure the nightmare and set a new record?

title: Grand Theft NY
description:
This amazing 3D game is a free online take on the legendary Grand Theft Auto game. As you play, you'll take control of a thief with assignments all throughout New York City. You have complete freedom to run and explore the game's open world.

Using the arrows to guide you to the control points, you must sprint across the city and complete over ten interactive levels.

In each level, you have the option to play missions with certain goals or just explore the world at your leisure.

title: Cool Orange Ball: Bounce Adventure
description:
Cool orange ball went on an adventure in which evil stones beat him, but the orange ball has 3 hearts. The game is similar to mario and sonic.

Game Features:
- Lots of exciting levels
- Various biomes
- Secrets in some levels
- Skins of colorful balls

Did you like the game Cool Orange Ball: Bounce Adventure? - Then try our other games and write a review on what to improve or what game we should release next!

title: Christmas Blind Box‌
description: This is a Christmas toy blind box opening game! Click the "Open" button to test your luck—can you beat the high score for the number of Christmas toys collected?

title: Obby Football Soccer 3D
description:
Online football / soccer and real sport — play with friends or random opponents.
Penalties and matches — score amazing goals, save shots, and become your team’s hero.
Obby challenges — train your reaction and speed while passing football obstacles.
Colorful 3D graphics and the atmosphere of a real stadium.

Go from rookie to champion. Prove that you are the best player in the world of football and sport.

title: Zombie Highway Rampage
description:
Drive your Rhino truck through hordes of zombies in this zombie apocalypse game.

Avoid incoming obstacles such as land mines, bounders, cars and other hazard materials.

Shoot and destroy obstacles with bullets.

title: Playground- Parkour
description: Jump and break bones, destroy enemies and unlock new levels! Ragdoll physics is what you need for parkour lovers. Train, participate in the battle and upgrade your hero! You will enjoy the game if you are a lover of the playground and stick games. Run, jump and maim the heroes. Ragdoll-style physics is what you love. Deals damage and unlock new levels! Stick and Ragdoll fans will be happy.

title: Geometry Subzero
description: Welcome to Ice Age in Geometry Subzero! The new interface of this game has captured any player's heart. Instead of a basic interface, you can experience the cold air when it's snowy in this game. The main character is a little monster who is frozen. The monster moves forward on a road with many spikes. Move, jump, and slide to overcome these dangers! In this game, the diversity of characters is one attractive feature. You can move a turtle, penguin, seal, etc to overcome challenges in this game.

title: Offroad Island
description: "Offroad Island" is an exciting racing game where you compete with different vehicles, earn money by completing missions, and customize your vehicles by upgrading them. Each map offers an adventure full of challenges. Are you ready for a journey full of speed and excitement?

title: C.A.P.
description:
Take to the skies and protect the carrier in this shooter inspired by WW2 dogfights. 
Dodge enemy fighters, protect your aircraft carrier, and blast through waves of incoming planes. 
Remember to come back to the carrier to refuel!
With crisp pixel-art 3D visuals and one-touch controls, this shooter delivers satisfying action perfect for short play.

title: Ragdoll Parkour Simulator
description: "Ragdoll Parkour Simulator" is an adrenaline-fueled parkour game that challenges players to navigate through urban environments with precision and style. With improved graphics and mechanics, players can expect an even more immersive experience than its predecessor.

title: Idle Merge Car And Race
description:
An addictive idle car merging game. Build your own car racing company and grow your business.
Move your cars to the racing track and earn money every time they cross the finish line. Buy new cars (or collect them from the gift boxes), and merge the same level cars to upgrade into a new type. The better the cars, the more money you will earn. Use your earnings to buy upgrade packages in the Shop to help you make money faster! Become the richest in the world in this idle merge car game.

title: Pool Merge Mania
description:
Pool Merge Mania!

Get ready for a wildly addictive twist on classic pool mechanics!
In Pool Merge Mania, shoot balls into the arena and watch them bounce, collide, and merge into higher-level balls. 

But beware, you can only have 15 balls on the table.

Tip: Fewer balls = more control. Merge them quick to stay in the game!

title: Bottle challenge
description: This is a puzzle game, the game provides different volumes of the kettle, according to the game level prompts each kettle needs a different magnitude, to reach the required magnitude of the prompt can be cleared

title: Fruit Jam - Merge Puzzle Game
description:
Fruit Jam - Merge Puzzle Game
Swipe fruits, blast combos & solve hundreds of juicy match-3 puzzles! Fun for all ages with vibrant graphics, daily rewards, offline play & no time limits. ?? Perfect for quick play or long sessions. Match, crush & enjoy!

Play now and test your brain!

title: Ride Shooter
description: What if the whole world is filled with zombies? Of course get in a car, equip it with weapons and armor, and then break through to the others! What's next? Machine gun, laser and attack helicopter!

title: HOTGEAR
description:
Join HOTGEAR, a brand-new racing game where the thrill of the chase is just beginning. The pursuit is on, and it's time to put your skills to the test! The game offers a wide range of customization options, allowing you to create the car of your dreams and make every chase even more thrilling.
So, what are you waiting for, racer? The pursuit has begun, and you're wanted! Time to get in the driver's seat, customize your car, and take on the streets!

title: Stick Boy: Bazooka Ragdoll
description: Unleash chaos in Stick Boy: Bazooka War! Blast through levels with a variety of powerful bazookas, each with unique abilities. Obliterate enemies, destroy bases, and demolish everything in your path. Choose the perfect ammo to send ragdoll foes flying and experience thrilling destruction as you crush their strongholds. Help Stick Boy annihilate all adversaries and conquer every level in this explosive adventure!

title: Plane Chase
description:
Ever watched a plane soar across the blue sky and thought, 'Hey, I could catch that… in my car!'? Well, your oddly specific and gravity-defying dreams are about to come true in 'Plane Chase'!

Fasten your seatbelts, rev the engine, and remember: it's not car theft if you're aiming for the plane! Are you ready for takeoff in the wackiest chase ever? Download 'Plane Chase' and steer your way through this high-flying, tire-screeching adventure. The skies are literally not the limit!

title: Nine Cards Of Winter
description:
Get into the holiday spirit with Nine Cards of Winter, a fun and relaxing tile-matching game!
Pick up to 9 Christmas tiles and match 3 of the same to clear them. Watch out — if your stack fills up, the game is over!
Use smart moves to uncover hidden tiles, solve tricky puzzles, and enjoy cute holiday designs.It’s easy to play, relaxing to enjoy, and full of winter charm!

title: MineTap Merge Clicker
description:
MineTap is an idle clicker with merge mechanics and crafting. Also there is an adventure, where you can fight zombies and other monsters and even build your own village!

Enjoy mining and treasure hunting. Complete quests and level up your character. Craft your ultimate weapon and slay epic monsters!
Have you ever had a dream to be a hero and save the world? Then tap to play and become a legend of crafting.
Start your epic mining adventure right now - click, tap & rock!

title: Prison Master: Escape Journey
description: Prison Master Escape Journey is a thrilling prison escape simulator that challenges your brain and strategic thinking! Trapped inside a high-security prison, you must plan every move carefully and begin an intense adventure toward freedom.

title: Two Stunt Supercars
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning supercar through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Demolition Car - Rope and Hook
description: Do you like casual simulators with physics of destruction? Looking for a free 3d game where you can break buildings? Control a wrecking machine with hook and rope. Compete with your friends in destruction and prove that you are the best house destroyer!

title: Rooftop Run
description: Run, jump, and slide over rooftops in this fast-paced parkour game! Dodge obstacles, smash through barriers, and escape from enemies as you race through exciting levels.

title: Cat Challenge
description: Meet the game Cat Challenge, where at each level the cat will patiently wait until you drop him a round colored candy disc. To do this, you need to cut the rope on which the candy dangles. But first, think about which side to do this and take into account the items that are on the playing field, they must be used to achieve the goal. The candy is not always directly above the cat, so it needs to be moved somehow.

title: Classic Mine Sweeper
description: Dive back into "Mine Sweeper Classic," the ultimate nostalgic puzzle game from the Windows XP era, perfect for strategic gameplay during any downtime. Challenge yourself with levels from beginner to expert and relive the excitement of this timeless classic.

title: Dynamons 9
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 9! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Halloween world and the bonus cave.

Encounter Tholanyx, Scarykin, Anubolt, Sauryx in frankenstein skin, Zonysus in Dracula skin and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Anime Doll - DIY Cosplay Girl
description: Dive into the enchanting world of Anime Doll - DIY Cosplay Girl, where you can live out your fashion dreams and become a master of anime dress-up!

title: Color Nonogram Puzzle
description: Play Color Nonogram free online and uncover hidden pictures in a relaxing browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Solve each grid using logic clues in a satisfying logic puzzle that doubles as a focused brain game. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, perfect for quick breaks. Fully mobile-friendly and optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game made for calm thinking and colorful puzzle fun anytime.

title: Cars Merge
description:
Feel the thrill as racing cars zoom by at lightning speed on the track!

Get your hands on these incredible cars and watch them blaze across the raceway. Show off your passion for speed and excitement by collecting them all!

How many will you collect? Play now and find out!

title: Ultimate Sports Car Drift
description: Dive into the world of Ultimate Sports Car Drift and feel the rush of adrenaline as you take on the ultimate drifting challenges. Whether you're a seasoned pro or a newcomer to the world of drift racing, this game offers something for everyone. Buckle up, hit the gas, and let the drifting madness begin!

title: Gemstone Glam
description: Welcome to the fabulous world filled with sparkling gems! Here you will meet two princess girlfriends who adore fashionable outfits and the glitter of colorful stones in fashionable outfits. Try on dresses inspired by the radiance of a diamond, the passion of a ruby, the freshness of an emerald and the mystery of an amethyst. Create shining combinations of hairstyles, dresses and accessories to transform young princesses into real fashion queens. Feel like a real stylist of the jewelry kingdom!

title: Idle Trade Routes
description: Command a growing fleet of merchant ships across a shimmering ocean in Idle Trade Routes. Link bustling islands, auto‑dock at busy ports, and optimize trade lines to keep goods flowing. Unlock new ships, hire captains, and chase bigger contracts as your profits grow even while you’re away.

title: Triangles
description:
If you like to organize your thoughts while playing, then "Triangles" is the game for you.
Combine, connect and match blocks in this exciting challenge that will test your logic skills. This king of puzzles will train your brain and help develop your logic and mental abilities. Don't let the shapes fill the hex grid!
The game will be interesting to fans of games with blocks.

title: Italian Brainrot Tung Tung Racing
description: Italian Brainrot Tung Tung Racing is a hyper-chaotic, turbo-charged racing game where logic goes to die and only the wildest survive. In a world where speed meets absurdity, you’ll choose from a trio of outrageous racers, strap into your customized Formula car, and blast through tracks so insane they might just melt your brain. This isn’t your average kart racer—this is pure, high-octane brainrot.

title: The Prism City Detectives
description: Embark on a vibrant adventure with "The Prism City Detectives" and join Luna, Ruby, Skye, Willow, Daisy, Violet, and Lumi in restoring color to their monochrome city! Explore dazzling dress-up levels and unravel hidden objects mysteries to find the missing Rainbow Gem and bring back the hues of unity.

title: PoppyTile
description: PoppyTile is a soothing and delightful tile-matching puzzle game set in a peaceful, picturesque countryside farm full of charm!

title: Royal Kitchen: The Lost King
description:
In a lost kingdom, disaster has struck! During a knight’s tournament, a mysterious figure in a black cloak suddenly appears. The stranger casts a spell on the king, causing him to vanish without a trace right before everyone’s eyes!

The princess manages to escape from the castle, but where should she go now? How can she save her father and the entire kingdom? Will she be able to overcome all the challenges, find her father, and defeat the evil wizard?

title: Bus Color Jam
description: Welcome to Bus Color Jam, a lively and colorful online game that challenges your coordination and quick thinking. Guide passengers to the right buses by matching their colors and keeping the station running smoothly. Every level brings new challenges that test your timing and attention. It’s a fun mix of strategy and reflexes — easy to learn, satisfying to master, and completely free to play on both your phone and computer.

title: Merge in Space
description: Merge in Space is a cosmic twist on the classic Tetris formula, where you must strategically merge falling astronomical objects of the same kind as they descend through the infinite void of space

title: Basketball Stars 2026
description: Basketball Stars is a cool 2 player basketball game by MadPuffers. Prepared for the 2025 basketball season. Choose your team and enter a challenging tournament. Control your player to perform awesome dunks and 3-pointers to win the game. Feel free to block and slap your opponent to knock him out and get the ball, and pay attention to the supershot bar on the top of the screen. Once fully loaded, you can use the hot special dunk from wherever you stand; it never fails. Be the best player!

title: 3D Ball Balancer
description: 3D Ball Balancer is a fun 3D rolling ball game. Control the ball to roll on the floating bridge. There are obstacles all over the floating bridge, including broken bridges, ramps, single-plank bridges, etc. Not only do you have to control the direction of the ball, but you also have to control the speed of the ball. How far you can go? Have a try!

title: Puzzles Balls Merge the New Year!
description: ● This New Year's game is more difficult than it might seem ?! You have a playing field? on which you need to throw balls and connect the same ones??! Until you get the biggest and most beautiful one?! Save up points?! Compete with friends and colleagues to become the best?! Enjoy your game?!

title: Blind Boat Shooting Master
description: Craft your raft and navigate through the colorful world. Take aim and fire to vanquish foes and gather riches. Featuring a unique comic book aesthetic and a diverse roster of over 30 characters, Raft Wars provides endless hours of fun for players of all skill levels. Dive into engaging turn-based battles against other pirates, thieves, and raft fighters as you journey across various lands and discover new territories. Dont miss out on the excitement - join the adventure today!

title: Jump In To The Plane
description: Want to feel like a super agent? Jump into a plane with your car! Race against time, perform crazy stunts, and wreak havoc in this insane game. Buckle up and put the pedal to the metal! Explore dozens of locations and vehicles. One wrong move and you're gone! Hurry, you've got a plane to catch!

title: Taxi Driver Simulator
description: Taxi Driver Simulator offers an immersive experience behind the wheel of a taxi. Complete Work Mode’s 80 levels with 3 yellow stars to become an eligible taxi driver. Follow the blue direction indicators, pick up passengers, and deliver them to their destinations efficiently. Slow down before steering to save time. Don’t forget to buy the other 9 cars in the garage as you earn money! In Free mode, drive farther and pay for fuel at gas stations. Keep serving customers without advancing levels.

title: Words Match
description: This catchy combo of word search and spelling bee lets you create thousands of words with different lengths. Try to improve your score while hitting the targets presented in every unique level, and upgrade your word tiles to keep progressing! Relax and train your brain at the same time - can you pass all the levels in Words Match?

title: Tag Run
description: Tag Run is an adrenaline-fueled multiplayer action parkour game where 1–4 local players race to ditch the bomb and be the last standing! Tag opponents, use teleport pads and jump springs, and survive thrilling matches with 6 players. Explore six dynamic maps: Pixel, Winter, Lava, Jungle, Candy, and Night, and packed with creative power-ups. Test your reflexes, strategy, and parkour skills in this fast-paced, chaotic playground challenge.

title: Witch Craft Potion Sort
description: Step into the witch’s lair this Halloween night and test your skills in a spooky potion puzzle! Sort the eerie liquids, mix glowing brews, and fill each cauldron with the right color to complete your craft.

title: Cross the Road
description: Experience the classic arcade action of Crossy Road in Roblox style! Navigate through endless roads, rivers, and train tracks, dodging obstacles and aiming for the highest score. With its vibrant voxel-style graphics and simple yet challenging gameplay, it's a nostalgic journey for both new and seasoned players.

title: Fashion Challenge: Catwalk Run
description: Fashion Challenge: Catwalk Run is a stylish dress-up game where you join glamorous catwalk competitions. Pick the perfect outfit, match accessories, style your hair, and impress the judges. Travel to fashion shows around the world, earn points, unlock outfits, and become a global trendsetter. Win challenges to climb the leaderboard and prove your fashion sense. Every level brings a new style theme to conquer!

title: Home Island
description:
Looking for a family adventure game? Try our Home Island: Family Pin free puzzle games about village life in paradise island! Pull the pin to solve the puzzle, follow the story and enjoy adventures on the island.
On the adventure for discovering the new island, a family cruise ship plane had to face an accident because of the bad weather. The father has gone missing, but the mother and their daughter luckily survived and got to a strange island.

title: Wood Screw Puzzle
description: Wood Screw Puzzle is a satisfying logic game where you untangle wood screws, nuts, and bolts from clever wooden structures. Each level challenges your spatial thinking as you analyze, plan, and carefully unscrew fasteners in the right order. Beautiful visuals and tactile mechanics make every puzzle feel rewarding and immersive.

title: Sandwich Runner
description: Sandwich Runner is a fun game. Collect ingredients on the way to the goal, how high will it reach? The diner is very hungry and he can't wait to eat. Collect steaks, chicken thighs, fried eggs, and sushi. Be careful to avoid bad food like mold and rot or it will make the diner sick! Red peppers will make the diner spitfire! Can you keep the diner happy and pass the level? Good luck!

title: I Am Security
description: Have you ever wanted to be a hardened security officer and be on the front lines of maintaining order? In I Am Security, an ultra-realistic role-playing simulator, you play the role of a professional security guard. You decide whether or not to allow them to enter. Some guests may try to sneak in with prohibited items and find these hidden items. Performs tasks in a variety of scenarios to identify suspicious persons.

title: Freecell Solitaire
description:
Put your mind to the test with FreeCell, one of the most beloved solitaire card games of all time!

Move cards between columns, use the free cells cleverly, and organize suits in ascending order to win.

Elegant graphics, smooth animations, and intuitive controls make every game a relaxing and satisfying experience.

Whether you're a solitaire veteran or a curious beginner, FreeCell will win you over with its perfect mix of simplicity and strategy.

title: GT Drift Most Wanted
description:
Drift your way around each level and hit all the snow piles while avoiding barriers. With responsive controls and a focus on timing and precision, players must master their drifting skills to clear each stage and become the ultimate Drift Master.
In this game, players can purchase different cars, each offering a unique driving experience. There’s no customization—just pick your favorite car and hit the track!

title: Barry Prison Hide And Seek
description: Begin an exciting escape game in the Barry Prison: Hide And Seek! Enter an exciting and challenging prison environment. You’ll join in a nervous game of hide and seek. Enjoy the fun role-playing. As the obby or Barry. Will you play as a brave escapee, or will you be the cold-hearted guard? Begin an exciting game of “hide and seek”, successfully hide and collect seals to defeat the boss, or find all the hidden escapees to stop their plans?

title: Steal Car Duel
description:
Step into a high-energy world of engines, rivalry, and fast reflexes. Steal Car Duel is a competitive action game that evolves the idea of Steal a Brainrot into a car-based experience filled with duels, rare collectibles, and endless upgrades!

Race, collide, and steal your way to the top. Build your own garage, earn coins and tickets, and outsmart rivals to prove who rules the arena. Each match combines skill, timing, and strategy as you fight for dominance in Solo or 2 Player mode.

title: Through the Wall 3D
description: Through the Wall 3D takes the mind-bending puzzle gameplay of the original Through the Wall to a whole new level with stunning 3D graphics! Test your reflexes, strategy, and flexibility as you contort your character to match a variety of dynamic shapes in a visually immersive world.

title: Apple Worm
description: Play Apple Worm now. This is a classic puzzle game with simple operation. Brain-burning levels make you love it! Control a cute little worm whose goal is to eat the apple and upgrade. Upgrading allows you to unlock more cute skins. You can also earn rewards by completing challenges. Unlock Auto ATK, Summoning, etc. Enter the snakey mode. Control your worm and eat the apples. Go through the obstacles and enter the portal without any problems!

title: Find the Sprunki
description: Find out the hidden Sprunki in the specified images. Each level has 12 hidden Sprunki. There are 12 levels in total. The time is limited so be fast and find all hidden objects before time runs out. Clicking in the wrong place several times reduces the time by an additional 5 seconds. So, if you are ready, start the game and have fun!

title: Rescue Sharp Turn
description: Rescue Puzzle 3D is a lightweight 3D fun puzzle game. You need to click on the correct objects in the small three-dimensional scene to trigger mechanisms, remove obstacles or form a chain reaction to meet the level conditions and rescue the injured character. The levels are short but full of ingenuity: turn off the power switch, move rocks, release water to extinguish fire, synthesize props...

title: Smash The Bottle
description: Bottle Smash Arcade is a fun, casual arcade smash game where you shatter bottles in wild combos—perfect for fans of cool math games and Roblox-style thrills. Master quick reflexes like in Minecraft challenge levels, or go old-school with snake game breaks. Help Captain Barnacles complete all the levels of this amazing underwater Bubbles game
