She wears leather jackets, spectacular corsets and accessories with pirate symbols. Who will win in this fashionable battle - a sophisticated beauty or a daring sea robber? The choice is yours!

title: Coffee Color Blocks
description: Coffee Color Blocks is a bright and relaxing puzzle game where you move colored shapes around the board and guide them to gates of the matching color. Each correct connection fills the cups inside the shape — your goal is to fill the entire figure without blocking the path.

title: Caillou Chef
description: In "Caillou Chef," Caillou puts on his apron and takes on the role of a chef in a fun and challenging café. The goal of the game is to help Caillou prepare delicious coffees and pancakes for his customers, effectively managing time to keep everyone happy with the service.

title: Max Crusher 2 - Destruction, Drift, and Racing!
description: Get ready for unbridled automotive chaos in Max Crusher 2 - Destruction, Drift, and Racing!– a game where the three elements of extreme driving merge: devastating crash tests, masterful drifting, and frantic racing!

title: Bubble Shooter Blast
description: In the game you can become an experienced bubble shooter. You just need to choose a ball and shoot at the right place to burst the bubbles. You have to go through more than 200 levels, so play this exciting game and start popping bubbles. Collect and shoot 3 or more bubbles to experience a sweet victory! Blow up all the balloons with your quick thinking and tactics. The next level will be harder than the previous one. Are you ready to burst all the balloons in this game?

title: Bang Bang Mahjong
description:
In Bang Bang Mahjong, we mix classic Mahjong with a sliding puzzle twist. It might seem simple at first, but as the levels get trickier, every move counts. Move the tiles around and match identical ones.

Power-ups like shuffle, remove, or hints can help when things get tough. With each completed level, the challenge grows—but so does the satisfaction of solving it. Who can master every puzzle and clear the board like a pro?

title: Fire Ball and Water Ball: Parkour Love Balls
description:
Fire Ball and Water Ball: Parkour Love Balls is an interesting parkour adventure and addictive ball game in the platform genre where orange fire ball and blue water ball running races. 

Help orange ball to get to the portal faster than the blue ball doing parkour tricks! The game is similar to mario.

Game Features:
- Multiple levels with colorful balls
- Various biomes
- Secrets in the back
- Orange fire and blue water ball skins
- The water ball girl goes through the levels with you!

title: Nitro Speed Car Racing
description:
Nitro Speed Car Racing is a very unique racing game. You need to focus on the pointer on the dial and stop it at the right moment to get the Nitro that can help you rush to the finish line. This
is a test of your quick reaction ability. Of course, you can use the coins you collected in the game to upgrade your engine and nitro. Come to a brain contest, stimulate your dopamine, and
challenge your reflex limit!

title: Mahjong Lines
description: Mahjong Lines is a relaxing logic puzzle in the mahjong connect style. Find matching tile pairs and clear the board by linking them with a valid path. With classic mahjong tiles, simple rules, hints, and lots of levels, it’s perfect for both quick sessions and thoughtful puzzle-solving.

title: Save the cats - Bubble shooter
description:
Think strategically, aim, shoot and get rid of all the bubbles.

Explore hundreds of levels with different levels of difficulty.

Be as accurate as possible to free all the cats.

Buy and use boosters on challenging levels.

To win - clear the field of all the balloons.

title: Number Bubble Shooter Wild West
description: Saddle up for a Wild West number bubble shooter! Shoot and match numbers to merge them into higher values, creating bigger combos and clearing the board. Plan your shots, stack smart, and ride through dusty levels full of challenge and fun!

title: Perfect Cake Maker
description: Get ready to make some seriously delicious cakes in Perfect Cake Maker! It’s a delightful casual simulation game. When you start, you’ll see a fully stocked kitchen and delicious guests waiting. First, choose the cake base based on your guests’ needs. Then comes the fun part – mixing the ingredients!

title: Leap and Avoid 2
description: Get ready for another thrilling journey with the white ball! "Leap and Avoid 2" brings new caves, lab levels, and fresh mechanics. Discover secret paths, collect coins, and unlock powerful bonuses like speed boosts and shields. Jump on white platforms, avoid black ones, and explore in all directions to find exits. The more coins you gather, the higher you rank. Compete with friends and uncover every hidden treasure!

title: Cosmic Aviator
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey through the depths of the cosmos in Cosmic Aviator! In this pulse-pounding arcade-style game, you find yourself piloting a sleek aircraft that's trapped within a twisting and treacherous tunnel of unknown origin. Your mission? Navigate through the endless labyrinth of obstacles and hazards while collecting valuable power-ups to boost your score to new heights.

title: Stunt Fury
description: Stunt Fury takes adrenaline-fueled stunts to new heights in this action-packed gaming experience. Strap in and prepare to defy gravity as you showcase your skills on a variety of daring platforms. With heart-pounding excitement around every corner, this game challenges players to push the limits of physics and creativity.

title: Bird Sort Challenges
description:
Bird Sort Challenges  is a fun and relaxing game where you sort colorful birds perched on branches, arranging them by matching colors.
Test your problem-solving skills as you strategize to ensure no branch overflows and complete each puzzle efficiently.
Whether you’re looking to unwind or sharpen your mind, Bird Sort: Color Sort Puzzle offers endless entertainment in a cheerful and visually pleasing world.
Good luck!

title: Word Connect Puzzle
description: Word Connect Puzzle is a relaxing yet brain-boosting word game. Swipe letters to form hidden words, unlock new packs, and watch the difficulty rise as your vocabulary grows. Earn stars, complete daily challenges, and use hints when you’re stuck. Play offline anytime, enjoy clean visuals and smooth controls, and chase streak bonuses for higher scores. Perfect for quick sessions or long puzzle runs—smart, simple, and satisfying for all ages.

title: 2048 Cube Shooting Merge
description: 2048 Cube Shooting Merge is an addictive merge puzzle online game for those who like challenging brain teasers and logic puzzle merge games. This game is in 3D with crazy fun physics! The squares don't stay in place, they pop up. The gameplay is much simpler. If you like 2048 games and want to play a novel mode, join the game.

title: Formula Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 stunning F1 cars with modified body kits and drive them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself in F1 Traffic Racer

title: Happy Monsters 2
description:
A bundle of fun games designed for children of all ages that will delight everyone!

Our little monsters love to play all sorts of games where you collect coins. Help them gather as many as possible to unlock all the toys. Complete the entire toy collection!

title: Horde Hunters
description: Horde Hunters is an idle and clicker game where you will earn money by killing zombies. Upgrade to a new level by merging soldiers, speeding up your shots, and increasing the amount of money you get. Shoot a horde of zombies from the top of a moving vehicle and get rich!

title: Murder Case Clue 3D
description: Murder Case Clue 3D is an exciting 3d escape game. You will play the role of detective, there was a murder recently, you need to find some clues and escape from this dangerous house. Be careful, good luck!

title: Food Card Sort
description: Food Card Sort is a unique and challenging 3D puzzle game that tests players' logic and reasoning skills. With a variety of food cards, each card displaying a different type of food, players must categorize them by placing similar foods together on the corresponding plate to pass each level.

title: Bloons Survival.io
description:
Bloons Survival. io is a fast-paced survival arcade game where you fight off endless waves of balloons!

Control your monkey hero, throw darts automatically, and pop incoming enemies before they get too close.
Collect coins and power-ups to grow stronger, but stay alert — one hit can end your run!

How long can you survive?

title: Escape from the Portal
description:
"Your soul is trapped between worlds. The only way home is to activate an ancient portal... but only one can pass through."
Explore gloomy catacombs, avoid traps, fight monsters, uncover secrets of the past, and use magical artifacts to open the portal and escape the underworld.

title: Planet Merge
description:
Embark on an interstellar journey in the most thrilling puzzle game of 2025! Merge planets in a cosmic challenge and create a universe of fun.
imple Yet Addictive Gameplay: Just drag and release to align the planets. Watch as they combine into spectacular new celestial bodies.

title: Lady Pool
description: We are glad to welcome you to the bright world of a humorous dress-up game where fashion collides with the comic book universe! Get ready for a creative reinterpretation of your favorite comic book anti-hero costumes: bold color combinations, unexpected prints and fun accessories are available to you. There is everything here: from funny hats that emphasize individuality to stylish superhero jumpsuits. Unleash your imagination!

title: Hexa Blast Game Puzzle
description:
Hexa Blast Game Puzzle is a fun and challenging game! Try to find the right combination of hexa puzzle. Just drag and drop all the hexa block game on the board. The rule is simple: everything must fit! Enjoy the satisfaction of pieces fitting neatly in place.
Our unique hexagonal pieces will stretch your mind in ways you never imagined in this addictive hexa block puzzle game.
Keep your brain active and sharp, analyze all the possibilities and try to finish all puzzles.

title: Bombardino Crocodilo terror jumpscare
description: Welcome to Bombardino Crocodilo: Terror Jumpscare, a spine-chilling horror game that will test your nerves, reflexes, and courage. In this twisted nightmare, you take on the role of an unfortunate visitor trapped inside a cursed, abandoned mansion. Your mission? Collect all the creepy dolls scattered across the dark, decrepit corridors and escape before its too late. Sounds simple? Think again.

title: Find 6 Differences – Spot the Hidden Changes!
description: Put your observation skills to the test in Find 6 Differences, a fun and relaxing puzzle game! With 20 unique levels, each featuring two nearly identical images, your goal is simple: find the 6 differences before time runs out! 20 challenging levels with beautifully designed images and engaging gameplay that sharpens your attention to detail. Hint system to help you when you're stuck.

title: Transformers Battle For The City
description:
In this game you will find an open world where you will defend the city from the invasion of robots. If you are a fan of transformers, then you will definitely like this game. 
In the game you will find 7 full-fledged story tasks, the complexity of which will gradually increase. After receiving the task, you will go to the place of military operations, where you can use various super-techniques to destroy powerful robot villains.

title: Fill The Bottle
description:
Fill The Bottle is a puzzle online game for all ages. The design of the canisters is different at each level, which makes you think about how to get the ball in the limited space without crossing
the line. Test your skill in maneuvering the balls and pass the levels with increasing difficulty.This fun and addictive game will keep you hooked as you come
up with clever ways to place the balls and unlock all the levels!

title: Fight Trivia
description: Fight Trivia is a mash-up of two popular game genre: the fighting games and the trivia games. You will have to answer 10, 30 or 50 questions, based on your level of knowledge. Choose an answer between a pool of four possible answers: if you guess right you will fight another opponent, otherwise you will be beaten up, and you will have to start the game from the first question! If you do not know the right answer you can always push the reward button to increase your chances.

title: Pumpking vs Mummy
description: Are you ready for a competitive game between the mummy and the pumpkin king on Halloween? Yes, someone has to win on Halloween! Team up with a friend and choose to be either the mummy or the pumpkin king. Collect as many flying pumpkins as you can! You can earn money by eating candies, and by gathering all the pumpkins, you can win the game. Catch the balloons and take them to the treasure chest. The one who collects and brings them back the fastest wins.

title: Colors Runners
description: Colors Runners is an interesting game that you can not miss. Slide to gather your companions of the same color and rush to the finishing line. Remember to walk the same way as your body color or you will get shot and fail. Challenge this game now!

title: Burger Day
description: Burger Day is a fun and fast-paced arcade game that puts you in charge of a busy burger kitchen. Stack ingredients to serve up tasty orders as quickly as possible. Your speed and decision-making skills are tested as customer demands increase. Satisfy hungry customers to unlock fresh challenges and advance through exciting levels.

title: Color Wood Animal Jam
description: Begin a charming logic puzzle match game in Color Wood Animal Jam. Drag the colorful wooden animal pieces into their correct spots. Complete each delightful jam puzzle. One wrong move can make the color block jam even trickier.

title: Koi Fish Pond - Idle Merge Game
description:
An addictive idle merging game. Build your own Koi fish company and grow your business.
Release your Koi fishes into the pond and earn money every time they cross the finish line. Buy new Koi fishes (or collect them from the gift boxes), and merge the same level Koi fishes to upgrade into a new type. The higher-level of the Koi fishes, the more money you will earn. Use your earnings to buy upgrade packages in the Shop to help you make money faster!

title: Merge Brainrot
description:
Drop and merge the most cursed Italian Brainrot memes!
From "Trallallero Trallala" to "Tum Tum Tum Saur! and "Boneca Ambalabu", they’re all here.
What final Brainrot will you unlock? Dare to find out!

title: Jungle Match Adventures
description: Jungle Match Adventures is a brand-new Match-3 game set deep in the lush Amazon Rainforest. Join the fearless explorer Aria as she uncovers hidden treasures, ancient relics, and precious gems buried in the jungle. Match colorful stones and nature-themed items, solve fun and challenging puzzles, and unlock secrets along the way. Take part in Daily and Weekly Challenges, enjoy Daily Surprises, and progress through hundreds of exciting levels in this unforgettable jungle adventure.

title: Formula Racers
description: Formula Racers is the ultimate HTML5 browser top-down arcade racing game - no download required! Race on any device across 10 thrilling tracks, tackle dynamic lap tracking and real-time placement, and earn coins to unlock and upgrade cars (engine, gearbox, steering, brakes). This online racing game features HD graphics, responsive design, immersive SFX & music - perfect for mobile & desktop gamers seeking fast-paced, addictive arcade action!

title: Mahjong Pet Quest
description:
Dive into the colorful and engaging world of Mahjong Pet Quest, a fun and relaxing puzzle game where classic Mahjong meets adorable animal tiles!
Replace the classic Mahjong tiles with cute animal-themed ones! Each tile brings a charming, delightful touch to the game.
Explore a variety of levels, each designed to test your skills and logic. The difficulty increases as you progress, ensuring that you’re always challenged!

title: Mahjong Magic Islands
description:
The wonderful world of the Magic Islands is in desparate need of magic to help restore the waning natural beauty of their ancient cities with a new wild energy. Tons of mythical creatures await your help throughout these scattered island. You are their only hope to be saved, fix these wonderful magic lands back to their former beauty!

Mahjong: Tile Match features classic mahjong solitaire in a uniquely original visual format.

title: Nubik Courier An Open World
description: Become a top pizza delivery expert! Race through city streets, dodge obstacles, and switch between vehicles to deliver pizzas on time. Earn money, upgrade your gear, and master exciting challenges. Fast-paced, fun, and addictive—start delivering now!

title: Doodle Football
description: Doodle Football is an imaginative and captivating 2D casual game that combines creativity, strategy, and fun. Your goal is simple: guide the football into the goal while overcoming exciting challenges across a variety of themes like the lush greenery of fields, the scorching sands of the desert, and the frosty landscapes of ice.

title: Make Two
description:
In Make Two, your job is simple. Give each customer two of the same food! Drag the matching items to the hungry customers before time runs out.

- Beat the clock to clear each level
- Match food pairs to fulfill orders
- Earn coins for every satisfied customer. The more you serve, the more you earn!
- Use your coins to unlock new cute customers.

Fast-paced, satisfying, and easy to pick up. Make Two is the perfect bite-sized game to test your reflexes and memory.

title: Weaponsmith Evolution - Weapon Merge
description:
- Start with basic weapons and drag identical ones to merge them into more powerful versions.
- Each new weapon brings more gold.
- Spend gold on upgrades: unlock new types of weapons or speed up the merging process.
- Fight monsters and progress through levels.
- From time to time, you’ll encounter powerful bosses. Defeat them to prove your mastery!

title: Fish Love Pins
description: Fish Love Pins is a physics-based game that requires players to actively use their brains to figure out how to complete each level. The game is very easy to play, but as you progress through the levels, the difficulty gradually increases.

title: Mahjong Connect Fish World
description: Mahjong Connect Fish World is a captivating puzzle game with an ocean theme. In this beautiful underwater world, players need to connect matching mahjong tiles to eliminate them, unlock levels, and explore a rich variety of marine creatures. The game combines traditional connect-style gameplay with an ocean theme, providing players with a relaxing and enjoyable gaming experience.

title: Snake Clash
description:
Fast-paced and Exciting free-run Snake PvP Gameplay.

Play as a snake and collect points to grow longer. Avoid the deadly tiles or use the snake body to break the tiles in your way! But watch out, because the snake will shorten as you use points. Quick decisions are key!

Compete with a different opponent in each battle.
Grow your snakes, avoid Skull Tiles and collect Battle Points to climb the daily leaderboard and be the One to claim the Snake Clash Crown.
Game on!

title: Ammo Rush Master
description:
Get ready to run, multiply, and blast your way to victory in Ammo Rush Master!
Dodge obstacles, choose the right gates, and build the biggest Ammo army of bullets. Then, grab your blaster and unleash a storm of foam darts to smash through targets, enemies, and bosses!

title: Snow Race 3d Fun Racing
description: Snow Race 3D: Fun Racing is an addictive arcade game. Do you want to participate in a snow race? This is probably the most fascinating and addictive game you have ever played! Collect the snow around you to make huge snowballs, then let them build ladders and climb to higher levels. Your opponents will have the same talent and you will have to race against time to race against them! Be the first to reach the finish line to win! Come join us and become a snowball master!

title: Cosmo Puzzle
description: Cosmo Puzzle is a colorful puzzle game about a robot who dreams of collecting a collection of minerals from all over the Solar System.

title: Dress Princess
description: You will transform into a fashion stylist, creating a unique look for the beautiful princess! The game offers a vast array of gorgeous clothing styles, from sparkling evening gowns to fresh and sweet daily dresses, everything is available. Every piece of clothing is carefully designed, with exquisite details displayed in every detail. ​

title: Math King - Math Skill Game
description:
Math King is the perfect game to help your kids to improve their Math skills in easy & fun way!
This game even helps you to develop calculation speed with high accuracy!

title: Boss Market
description: You are the owner of your market. Customers are coming to buy various products. Collect these products and place them into correct stands so that customers can buy them. Collect money from customers and open new markets and become a market boss!

title: Merge Fusion
description: Merge Fusion is an entertaining and addictive casual game where you combine and evolve items to create superior versions. The goal is to drag and merge identical items, triggering new fusions and unlocking more challenging levels as you progress. The game features simple, relaxing gameplay that is perfect for unwinding. Experience the satisfaction of watching your creations grow progressively in complexity as you explore new possibilities with each merge.

title: Squid Game Memory Card Match
description:
Step into the thrilling world of Squid Game Memory Card Match! Test your memory and focus as you uncover pairs of iconic Squid Game symbols and characters. Can you keep your cool under pressure and match all the cards before time runs out?
Challenge yourself or compete with friends to see who can master the ultimate memory test. With Squid Game Memory Card Match, every flip brings you closer to victory or defeat – can you handle the pressure?

title: Click Click Clicker
description: Click Click Clicker is a single-player, idle clicker game where you earn money by clicking the button on the screen. Unlock various buttons, cursor styles, themes, and music.

title: Tanks. Race for survival
description: In this exciting tank game, you compete with other players to be the first to reach the finish line, destroying enemy towers along your way. Control powerful tanks, use tactical thinking and strategic maneuvers to overcome obstacles and defeat opponents. Carefully plan your route, avoiding enemy attacks and traps on the path to victory. The thrilling survival race begins here!

title: Urban Assault Force
description: Step into the boots of an elite counter-terrorism unit in Urban Assault Force, an intense first-person shooter that plunges you into the heart of urban warfare. The city is under siege by a ruthless terrorist group, and it's up to you and your team to strike back and save the day.

title: Scary Baby Yellow Game
description:
You have a new babysitting job, and things are becoming odd. Feed him, give him a bedtime tale, and avoid falling into his nightmares about him. How long can you maintain control?

Try to care for a weird infant in a lonely and unusual residence. Look for the baby in each area and follow the directions to reach your objective and finish the level.

title: Money Factory - Earn a Billion
description: Prepare for a thrilling journey into the world of finance! As the owner of a money factory, you'll build and link mechanisms to boost your earnings with every step. Overcome exciting challenges where strategy is crucial to your success. Collect powerful boosters, create combos, and unlock new levels to discover even more ways to grow your fortune. Upgrade your factory to fast-track your rise to riches and become a financial powerhouse!

title: Kick and Ride
description: Kick and Ride is a physics-based puzzle game consisting of two game modes. Drag and drop the block to make path for the soccer as well as for the vehicle. Enjoy the vibrant and colorful beach themed game.

title: Mine & Slash
description:
Embark on an epic RPG quest, as you dig and explore your way through a rougelike 3D world filled with magic and adventure.

As a miner, you have the unique opportunity to collect gold and valuable resources as you dig deeper and deeper into the dungeon. Unlock powerful skills to become even stronger!

title: Tap Tap Builder
description:
"Tap Tap Builder invites you to build the city of your dreams and become its mayor! But before leaning back in a comfortable boss's chair, you'll have to roll up your sleeves and do some work. Want to build a skyscraper? Tap-tap and you're done! Not enough money? Tap-tap and earn some! A fire broke out? Tap-tap and save your people!

Let's start working right now, tap-tap the PLAY button!

title: Javelin Battle
description: Javelin Battle is a spear-throwing physics puzzle game with 2D stickman models. We need you to eliminate all incoming enemies at each level in the Normal Mode. When you destroy enemy infantry's shields, they will run to you quickly. I strongly suggest you destroy the enemy spearmen on the platforms first. Don't forget to choose skills to increase your abilities and power. Keep calm and aim carefully.

title: Air Strike 2D
description: Become a bomber pilot and fly an army airplane in epic air strikes! Drop bombs, destroy tanks, cannons and soldiers, intercept missiles and shoot down drones. Eliminate enemy troops and destroy their military bases. Upgrade your aircraft with deadly weapons and cool gear. Dominate the battlefield from the sky and defeat the villain general in a final airstrike!

title: Celebrity Thanksgiving Prep
description: It’s Thanksgiving, and the celebrities are getting ready for the big day! In Celebrity Thanksgiving Prep, you’ll help your favorite stars get glammed up for the holiday dinner. Start by creating stunning makeup looks, styling hair, and choosing the perfect fall outfit. Then, join them in the kitchen for some festive cooking fun! From cozy sweaters to chic party dresses, show off your fashion taste and creativity in this delightful seasonal makeover game.

title: Two Dots Remastered
description: Welcome to Two Dots Remastered, a fun and popular HTML5 connecting game enjoyed by gamers of all ages! Two Dot Remastered’s gameplay is straightforward: Match two or more dots in the same color (not diagonal ones) and then blast them! Enjoy playing Two Dots Remastered, the ultimate connecting game for gamers of all ages, and become a master at connecting dots!

title: Bubble classic
description: The goal of the game is not to lose as early as possible and to score as many points as possible. Improve your accuracy thanks to very competent rolling of balls. The more blocks with balls you destroy, the more points you accumulate. Check your results in the world rankings, maybe you are already number 1.

title: Eat Blobs Simulator
description: The battle of the blobs and slimes is beginning in this great eating simulator. Pick your slime character and start competing against others. Eat smaller blobs and slimes, and make yours bigger than the others. Become the king of the blob arena! Buy various blob skins during the game. On each game, receive various rewards with the blob sizes and coins. Chase smaller blobs and eat them. Collect blobs around and increase your score.

title: Rough Ball
description: Bounce wildly in Rough Ball! Control your cute purple ball across wall-to-wall platforms, dodging spikes, skulls, and deadly drops. Collect shiny coins, unlock free burger skins, and conquer chaotic levels. Don't fall down—jump, roll, and thrive in pixel-perfect adventure!

title: Ball Sort: Color Puzzle
description: An exciting and engaging puzzle game. Move the balls into the flasks to sort them and advance to the next level. The game has many levels, each more challenging than the last! Can you reach the end?

title: Trading Games Playtime
description: Hey there, game lovers! Get ready to embark on an exciting journey with Trading Games Playtime, the ultimate casual game that's all about relaxation and non-stop fun! This game is a magical blend of various mini-games, making it a one-stop destination for your entertainment needs. First off, it doubles as a fantastic antistress simulator.

title: Springle Puzzle
description: Springle Puzzle is a fun and fast jigsaw game where you solve puzzles before time runs out. Choose from styles like Classic, Irregular, Hexagon, or Wave, each with a different feel. Play easy mode with fewer pieces for a quick game and lower score, or pick more pieces for a harder challenge and higher score. If time runs out, watch a reward ad and keep playing.

title: Football Stars Championship
description: Try a fresh take on a football game! The luck-based gameplay will keep you on your toes. Score extra points with precise shots that avoid the goalkeeper perfectly.

title: Slidee
description: In this sliding-puzzle game you will have to make your way by painting the walls. Along the way you'll encounter spikes, portals, and collapsing walls.

title: Pocket Car Master
description:
Pocket Car Master: The Ultimate Car Puzzle Game
Collect and merge parts to make your own robot car. Park it in the matching area and fight other robots. No time limit, just fun. Upgrade your car with coins and unlock more cars. Try and play now!

title: Run Friends
description:
'RUN FRIENDS' is a game where beautiful heroines run to save planets in danger. 
Rescue the various creatures (Friends) on each planet, threatened by the cosmic villain Vegapunk, and save the planets. 
Are you ready to run alongside these beautiful heroines?

title: Card Battle
description: Come to enter the exciting world of card battles, where strategy is combined with passion! In this card puzzle game, each card has its unique powers. Before the game. Choose to upgrade your coins or strength.

title: Nubik: Create Your Place
description:
Nubik: Create Your Place – a game about Nubiks. In this game, you can create your own 'place' – meaning your own game. Choose the game type, build a level from blocks, set Nubik spawn points, and play.

You can play the game solo or with a friend. However, you can also create a 'place' (game) and simply watch how Nubiks (bots) play it.

The game features many skins for Nubiks, achievements, a leaderboard, and chat.

title: Bubble Shooter Wild West
description: Saddle up for a Wild West adventure in Bubble Shooter Wild West! Join Sheriff Bonnie as you pop colorful bubbles to defend your frontier town. Travel through dusty deserts, lively saloons, and scenic canyons while enjoying toe-tapping country tunes. Track your progress with detailed stats showing your best, current, and previous scores across Novice, Expert, and Master modes. With its vibrant Western visuals and exciting challenges, this bubble shooter brings cowboy spirit to every pop!

title: THE SURVEY
description:
After a long work time when you ready to play games in your computer and start a survey  and it's shows you the things that you don't want to watch and know!
- 5-10 min Gameplay
- Atmospheric Enveronment
- Intrective Gameplay

title: GT Championship Arcade
description: Get ready to ignite your engines and experience the ultimate rush of speed in GT Championship Arcade! This fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled racing game brings the excitement of GT racing into a visually stunning, arcade-style world filled with neon-lit tracks, intense rivalries, and heart-pounding action. Whether you’re a casual gamer looking for quick thrills or a hardcore racing fan seeking the ultimate challenge, this game offers an electrifying experience like no other.

title: IDLE Pet
description: Anatomical clicker. Start with one cell and create a whole animal! You will see what the body is made of from the inside, gradually growing bones, organs, skin and wool!

title: Unlock the Bolts
description: Unlock the Bolts is a challenging puzzle game where you carefully remove screws to solve mechanical puzzles. Each level tests your logic and precision as you figure out the correct order to unlock the bolts. In special levels, the stakes are even higher—you must free trapped animals by unlocking the right bolts! With satisfying mechanics and engaging challenges, this game will keep you thinking and entertained. Can you master every puzzle and rescue the animals in need?

title: Boxing Gang Stars
description: The stars are in the boxing ring and it is time to fight! These funny boxing characters are trying to destroy each other either in 1 player or in 2 player mode. Start this boxing competition and become the king of the boxing rings! Super fun physics with fun characters is waiting for you! Let the box fights begin!

title: Mystical Blade 3D
description: Enter the world of Mystical Blades, where you design and battle your own B-Blades! Mix blades, rings, and elements to create powerful combos, then face players worldwide in thrilling battles. With stunning graphics and realistic physics, prove your skills and become the ultimate B-Blades master!

title: Texas Holdem Poker
description: Players compete for winning combinations of cards using their skills and intuition. The game has the ability to bet, bluff and recognize the bluff of other players. Players can choose different difficulty levels and customize their own game rules. The unique interface design and realistic atmosphere allow you to immerse yourself in the world of card games and enjoy the excitement anytime and anywhere.

title: Hidden objects: Lost Island 2
description: Discover an immersive adventure on a lost island full of secrets, mysteries, and ancient artifacts. Together with a charismatic explorer, you’ll find yourself deep in tropical jungles where a forgotten temple of an ancient civilization lies hidden beneath overgrown vines and trees. Every location is a handcrafted scene packed with hidden objects, puzzles, and clues about the mysterious past.

title: Daily Horoscope HD
description: Daily Horoscope HD offers personalized daily horoscopes at your fingertips. Click on your zodiac sign to uncover insights into your day, with the option to watch an ad for access to other sign readings.

title: Obby Modes! Online Mini-Games
description:
Is a massive online world where three unique modes are waiting for you!

Take on the challenge of 100 levels of hard obby, compete in crazy races with 5 players, and test your fate on a glass bridge in the spirit of Squid Game!

Create your unique character by choosing from over 100 cool skins!

Team up with friends using a code in squads of up to 3 people and conquer all modes together!

Ready to show off your agility and strategy? Set records and become a legend!

Draw patterns, summon stickman defenders in 3 seconds, facing relentless enemy vehicles. Upgrade characters, navigate intense environments, and stop foes from breaching. Embark on a thrilling adventure, showcasing tactical mastery against relentless waves!

description: In this thrilling game with a cubic style, the character attempts to escape from prison by progressing through levels, each represented as a separate platform. On each level, you'll need to collect coins that help speed up your escape, but be careful: dangerous traps and obstacles await at every turn. A wrong move or misstep could cost you your life. Navigate through each level, avoid the threats, and move closer to freedom!

title: Crazy Bike Stunts PvP
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning muscle car through 2 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Crazy Bike Stunts PvP!

title: TimeWarriors
description:
Lead your army to glory through the ages! Embark on an epic journey through history. From primitive battles of the Stone Age to the futuristic wars of the future — become the greatest commander the world has ever known.

Become a great commander and lead your army to victory! Play “Time Warriors” now!

title: Urus City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning sports SUV through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Hidden Objects Island
description: Discover the ultimate hidden objects game and embark on a journey through stunning locations, captivating puzzles, and mysterious adventures!

title: Vehicle Fun Race
description: Vehicle Fun Race—an exhilarating arcade game with 3D stickman characters. Collect motorcycles, cars, boats, and helicopters to reach the finish line. No need to grab vehicles; your character can handle all terrains. Dive into water? No problem—control their swim. Special helicopters await on final platforms. Ready to race? Let’s roll!

title: Italian Brainrot Find the Differences
description: In this game you have to locate the differences between the two pictures in the limited amount of time given to play each time! To play, use your mouse as control. Make sure that you don’t make a mistake more than three times because that will make you fail. One minute is the total time you will play through the 20 levels in this game! In each level you have seven differences. Good luck!

title: Is it right
description:
This puzzle game will challenge your wits and attentiveness - do it right!
Look for pumping logic, look for the right colors, go through levels, open skins!

title: LABUBU MERGE CLICKER
description:
Enter the wacky world of Labubu and the Monster Crew — merge mischievous Labubus, unlock rare forms, and climb your way to the top!
Boom! Crash! Roar! The gang’s all here — how far can you go before the box overflows?

title: Cube Speed Dash
description: Jump, dash, and survive in Cube Speed Dash, a high-speed arcade challenge where every second counts! Master lightning-fast reflexes as you guide a nimble cube through treacherous obstacle courses filled with spikes, traps, and deadly pitfalls. One wrong move—and it’s game over!

title: Merge Heroes Titans
description:
In this game, you will command squads of melee fighters and ranged archers fighting against waves of enemies. Your agility and strategic thinking will give you an edge to victory.

Unlock new powerful fighters and accurate archers by combining those available for purchase. Place them on the map according to abilities and win.

You will have to discover not only new characters, but also beautiful different worlds, enjoy our new game.

title: BBQ Sort Puzzle
description:
This is an interesting elimination puzzle game!

You need to put three identical items into the same grill to complete the grilling.

The difficulty of the game increases step by step.

title: Color Race Obby
description: Color Race Obby is an exciting game inspired by Roblox and Obby. Compete with players online on a field of colored blocks. Enter the race and become the champion! Join the fun!

title: Romantic K-Pop Transformation
description: In this game, the stars of K-pop are preparing for a romantic transformation. Create a unique images for girls, full of tenderness and brilliance of the stage. Experiment with makeup; change the hairstyles and hair color of the girls. Choose the perfect outfit: from cute dresses and stylish tops to trendy skirts and trousers. Complete the look with fashion accessories. Compare the resulting images and decide which of the heroines of the game has become the real queen of romantic K-pop style.

title: Snake 2048
description: Start as a small cube in this thrilling online game! Eat smaller snakes, dodge stronger ones, and grow into a giant. Enjoy endless challenges, competitive leaderboards, and exciting gameplay. Play now and dominate the arena!

title: TCG Card Clicker
description: TCG Card Clicker is an addictive clicker game inspired by TCG Card Shop Simulator, where collecting never stops! Click to earn coins, open card packs, and expand your collection with over 8000 unique cards. Each card boosts your passive income, letting you earn more even when you're not clicking! Trade duplicates to discover new cards and complete your ultimate collection. Can you find the rarest cards and become the ultimate collector

title: Sprunki Puzzles and Singing
description: Before the sprunks take on their immediate duties, namely creating music, you must unlock sixteen characters. In the meantime, you have no one to create your own melodies with. To bring the Sprunki back to life, you must collect an image of each Sprunki. The picture consists of nine square fragments that are mixed on the playing field. Swap them and install them in the correct positions. Having collected all the puzzles, you can start making music in Sprunki Puzzles and Singing.

title: Frog Byte
description: Frogbyte is a game about a hungry toad sitting on a leaf that wants to eat all the flies flying through its swamp. Try to catch as many bugs as you can avoiding the bombs, otherwise it will be game over! Make the best score and share it with your friends!

title: Toilet Pin
description: Join the daily story of the toilet boy in the monster letter world. This new pin pulling game is for you. Let's explore Alphabet Lore with extraordinary characters! In the land of evil letters, you will have a chance to meet various amazing characters and powers of them: evil B ready to punch in your face, Angry C biting with sharp teeth, boring F with a gun, Crazy Z with fire, monster D who loves lava ....

title: Goodeluxe
description: Goo Deluxe is a Collapse game with a sticky and satisfying aesthetic. It's a simple and relaxing game. Unlike other Goobox games, Goo Deluxe is not limited by time, allowing you all the time to think. Isn't that true luxury?

title: Mutant run
description: When you are running on a track full of various obstacles, you need to choose to go through the mutation gate to evolve your body, gain the talents of specific animals, and clear the obstacles in the road!

title: Car Jam: Traffic Puzzle
description: Get ready for Car Jam: Traffic Puzzle, the ultimate test of logic and fun! Untangle the traffic, move the cars, and clear the way in this addictive puzzle adventure. With every level, new challenges appear—packed parking lots, tricky buses, and colorful traffic jams waiting for your brainpower. Easy to play, hard to master, and endlessly entertaining.

title: GT Cars Mega Ramps
description: Exotic cars, mega ramps, colorful giant bosses and face to face races all come together in this game. GT Cars Mega Ramps invites you to a fantastic driving experience with its completely unique game-play. Fly over mega ramps with your customized exotic car, destroy giant bosses or try to finish the stages first in face to face races!

title: Cards 2048
description: Are you looking for a fresh twist on a familiar game? Cards 2048 is the perfect blend of classic solitaire and the popular 2048 puzzle game! This unique combination creates an engaging brain teaser that's highly addictive. As you merge cards with matching numbers, the challenge intensifies, offering a true test of your skill and strategy. Sharpen your logic and enjoy hours of fun with Cards 2048, the ultimate card merging game for puzzle enthusiasts!

title: Merge Food Puzzle
description: Merge Food Puzzle is a synthetic puzzle game. What is different from ordinary match-3 games is that successful matches will not disappear and will generate higher-level food. The game has two modes: Merge BBQ and Merge Fruit. Merge BBQ has a variety of barbecues waiting for you to unlock, including corn, cauliflower, fish, squid, and more. Have fun!

title: Funny Fruits: Merge and Gather Watermelon
description: Merge the cheerful fruits, combine them to help them evolve into something even tastier! Hurry to gather more of them to prevent the box from overflowing. Can you collect all the fruits and grow a huge watermelon? Compete with friends for higher scores!

title: Italian Animals: Create Your Own Brainrot!
description: Create your own crazy Brainrot! Mix bodies, heads, and legs to create absurd Italian creatures, listen to their "passports" and keep your masterpieces as keepsakes. Creative chaos is in your hands!

title: Bubble Shooter Free 3
description: Bubble Shooter Free 3 is back with a long-awaited 3rd sequel to one of the most popular bubble shooter games there is! This bubble shooter embraces endless gameplay that is designed for players to enjoy hours and hours of fun without time pressure. It boasts the ‘Bubble Swap’ feature which lets you swap the current bubble in your shooter with the incoming one as well as the BOMB which creates huge explosions popping 15 bubbles at once! Now the players can play even more strategically!

title: Park Them All!
description: Park Math Mania is a free, fun casual arcade where players drive, park, and solve math puzzles just like a cool math game. Perfect for students searching for “cool math game,” “freebie parking fun,” or “parking puzzle” challenges. With clever car-parking levels and brain-teasing math twists, this freebie delivers the ideal blend of driving excitement and math brain training. Download now for a unique parking dash and learning adventure!

title: MeatRider
description: Welcome to "MeatRider" — an intense action-packed game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. You find yourself right in the middle of the chaos, where your only goal is to survive at all costs. Choose one of the unique combat vehicles, each with its own special abilities and weapons, and get ready for dynamic battles across a zombie-infested desert landscape.

title: Mahjong Crimes - Puzzle Story
description:
MYSTERIOUS FEATURES

Play 100+ Mahjong exciting levels! 
Dive into Agatha Christie's stories 
Use boosters and collect tile sets

PLAY MAHJONG

Mahjong Crimes is a puzzle game where you match tiles to find clues and solve crimes. Use power-ups to beat tricky levels and win awards!

SOLVE CRIMES

Join detective Hercule Poirot on the Orient Express to solve crimes in this Mahjong game! Match tiles to investigate, defeat thugs, and untangle mysteries. Fun guaranteed!

title: Picture Puzzles
description: the picture puzzles includes dozens of different puzzles. you can increase or decrease the number of pieces of these puzzles as you wish. so you can make it suitable for all ages. you can have a pleasant time by having fun and exercising your brain. come on we are waiting for you.

title: Tsunami Race
description: Have you ever faced the thrill of escaping a giant tsunami? In this action-packed game, you’ll choose from a variety of unique characters and race to stay ahead of your opponents. The game offers three exciting modes: outrun a tsunami in Tsunami Race, dodge flying fruits in Fruit Run, and slide to glory in Water Slides—knocking down opponents and collecting boosters along the way. Only the fastest and most strategic players will emerge as champions!

title: Tung Tung Sahur in Geometry Dash
description: Join Tung Tung Sahur, the wooden drum-carrying dawn caller, as he bounces and flips through a neon cityscape just before sunrise! Dodge spikes, leap over traps, and time your jumps to the beat of his signature “tung-tung!” calls. In this Geometry Dash–inspired challenge, the streets are alive with glowing gates, speed pads, and tricky gravity flips. Can you drum your way to the end without missing a beat?

title: Striped Fruit - Watermelon Land
description:
Welcome to the enchanting world of Striped Fruit that full of strategy and fun. Here, you'll become a watermelon maker extraordinaire, mastering the art of fruit merge to create the juiciest combinations on the board. As a merge master, you'll tap, drop, and combine fruits in a strategic dance.

The challenge? To reach your way to the top, the first step is to merge 2 melons to create a watermelon - the King of Fruits. Can you merge 2 watermelons to smash them out? Let's check it out!

title: Merge Numbers
description: Merge Numbers is a relaxing HTML5 game to play, the objective of the game is to combine two same tile or number into one, then tile number will be upgraded and score will be increased. The game will ended if there is no room or movement available in the board.

title: Muscle Challenge
description: Run, eat healthy foods and proteins and avoid harmful foods, drinks and obstacles in the Muscle Challenge game! Defeat your enemies with the strength and muscular body you gained at the end of the race! The enemies get stronger in each level, so you have to get better too... If you want, you can also play the game in challenge mode with your friend in 2 Player mode.

title: Mine Jump
description: Jump into action! ? Test your logic and reflexes in this addictive game. Collect slugs, upgrade your hero, and uncover the secrets of a mysterious planet! ?✨

title: Merge Shooter
description: In "Merge Shooter," defend the galaxy by merging turrets to fight off alien invaders. Enhance your defense with special powers, navigating through levels filled with challenges. With its colorful graphics and user-friendly interface, it's an exciting adventure for all ages. Become the galaxy's hero by proving your achievements in this dynamic gameplay experience.

title: Animal Merge Zoo Park
description:
Animal Merge Zoo Park is a fun and addictive idle zoo simulation game where you build, manage, and expand your very own wildlife empire. Start with a small zoo and grow it into a world filled with animals, wild beasts, dinosaurs, monsters, and magical creatures like unicorns. Become the ultimate zoo tycoon by merging creatures, caring for animals, producing food, managing visitors, and unlocking new zones.
Merge Animals and Discover New Species

title: Animal in Rails!
description:
An exciting puzzle game about delivering animals to a trader's base

Connect and disconnect railways around the world to help each animal reach its home.

Install, remove, and redirect connections so that wagons can safely connect to the locomotive. But be careful and don't let them collide with each other!

Delay trains by using railway barriers. Change the tracks to redirect the wagons in different directions. Pick up new pets along the way and face even more challenges along the way!

title: Physics Balls
description: Physics Balls is a creative and challenging math and physics puzzle game. Here has numbers and ball elements. Improve your logical thinking and hands-on skills while having fun. Your aim is to break all bricks in one shoot. Throw balls to make them roll among the bricks. You can apply physical principles to control the balls cleverly.

title: Knife Master : Ball Racing
description:
Chop chop chop, throw the knife, but don't hit the ball~!
It's like the mastery of circus performer. Which means, it's fun! Let's be the master of throwing knives and bounce the ball to the sky!

title: Grand Mahjong
description: Grand Mahjong is a captivating multi-level puzzle game based on the traditional Chinese Mahjong. Match identical tiles, clear the pyramid, and progress through increasingly challenging levels. This game is perfect for fans of logic games, brain puzzles, and anyone searching for a fun free Mahjong online experience.

title: Bubble Letters
description: Dive into the enchanting realm of Bubble Letters, an immersive word game that takes players on an extraordinary journey through the world of letters. Featuring vibrant floral backgrounds and tranquil gameplay, this online crossword adventure is the ideal companion for warm days ahead! With thousands of levels to conquer, you're guaranteed endless brain-teasing enjoyment. Embark on a blooming linguistic adventure today!

title: Mr Long Legs
description: Get ready to wobble, stretch, and stumble with Mr. Long Legs, the funniest physics puzzle game you’ll ever play! Step into the shoes of a long-legged stickman hero and control his stretchy legs to cross impossible terrains.

title: Drive-in Cinema: Idle Game
description: Drive-in Cinema: Idle Game lets you build your perfect movie theater and run a profitable business. Choose the best films to satisfy guests and increase income. Expand parking, open snack kiosks, automate processes, and hire employees to optimize operations. Complete over 50 missions, enjoy colorful 3D graphics, and immerse yourself in a unique atmosphere. Buy movies, prepare snacks, and grow your theater to attract more viewers. Ready to become the top drive-in owner?

title: Frogga
description: Guide Frogga across a busy road in this exciting frogger-style game. Tap to make Frogga jump forward, timing your movements carefully to avoid the oncoming traffic. Each level presents new challenges with faster cars and trickier obstacles, keeping you on your toes. Collect bonuses and power-ups along the way to help Frogga on his journey.

title: Ramp Bike Jumping
description: Perform the most unimaginable stunts on motorcycles, bicycles, even skis! There’s no backbone to be broken here! And we know a guy who knows a guy, whose sister-in-law bent some laws of physics for us. That’s right, you can get really crazy with our game. So buckle up, or not... It doesn’t matter. The only thing that matters is pure fun and madness!! YEE-HAW!

title: Organizer master
description: An engaging 3D puzzle with numerous levels. Find pairs and arrange objects so that everything fits. Develop spatial thinking and solve challenges. Enjoy high-quality 3D graphics in this captivating browser puzzle game.

title: Horseback Survival
description: Embark on a journey of survival in "Horseback Survival," where you, as Zohan, share an unbreakable connection with your horse, Badal. Born on the same day, your unique bond becomes a lifeline when a mysterious event leaves you in a coma. Navigate a zombie-infested world. Engage in intense combat with melee and ranged attacks, outsmart the undead by staying stealthy, and overcome obstacles with strategic running and jumping.

title: Merge Brick Breaker
description: Welcome to Merge Brick Breaker, the ultimate fusion of ball merging and brick-breaking action! Get ready to embark on a thrilling adventure that challenges your strategic skills and reflexes.

title: Fast Ball Jump
description: Let’s prepare yourself to feel happy and relaxed by playing going balls. Roll, spin, jump and don’t lose lives because unexpected obstacles lie ahead. Get ready & participate in an epic roll ball race in a different environment. You will have a lot of fun in your spare time by playing green ball run 2048 and journey ball sky.

title: Spider-Noob obstacle course
description:
Noob was bitten by a creeper-spider and became a spider-noob! Help Noob train in the big city, fly on webs, collect badges, unlock new costumes, and complete challenges. Unlock new levels. 

Complete all the levels and turn Noob into a Pro-spider

title: Slingshot Fortress
description: Slingshot Fortress is an addictive 2D physics-based destruction game where precision, timing, and strategy are essential. Use your slingshot to launch stones, bombs, and shurikens to destroy towers, collapse structures, and uncover hidden enemies. Explore vibrant levels from forests to icy lands, unlock powerful abilities, trigger explosive chain reactions, and master increasingly challenging puzzles in this fun, casual browser game experience.

title: Glitch
description:
Glitch is a 2D platformer game where you must solve challenging puzzles to overcome the glitching platform and reach the finish door. Get ready for a gaming experience like no other, whether you’re a fan of puzzles, action, or platformers. Start your adventure!

Innovative Puzzle Mechanics: Tackle a range of puzzles designed to test your problem-solving abilities. Each level offers a unique brain teaser, from classic logic challenges to cutting-edge new mechanics.

title: Stickman Miners Wars
description: Lead your stickman king to victory in Stickman Miners Wars, where strategic decision-making is key. Command an army of miners and warriors to build your forces and triumph over opponents. Upgrade your units and yourself as you gain experience, and strategically attack enemy castles while defending your own. Will your strategy lead you to dominance? Play Stickman Miners Wars now!

title: Solitaires Crime Stories
description:
Solitaire Crime Stories is an exciting new Solitaire game which will carry you away into a world of fascinating criminal investigations, colorful characters and stunning locations. Test your skills by completing interesting levels and unraveling the   mysteries of the town of Springdale!
    Springdale is a small American town that lives in peace and quiet... but that’s only at first glance. Everyone hides secrets here, secrets that could tear this carefree town apart.

title: Jelly Math 3D
description: Play Jelly Math 3D free online and explore a colorful browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Solve addition and subtraction, discover shapes, and tackle each logic puzzle in a playful 3D brain game designed for curious minds. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home. Fully mobile-friendly and built for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game that turns learning into quick, fun, skill-boosting play anytime.

title: Echolocation Shooter
description:
Shoot to see in the dark!

Eliminate all the neon enemies, in the horroristic level!

The only way to see in this FPS is to generate soundwave with your weapon.

Survive endless waves of the wide variety of enemies, where the only way to see is to shoot. Unleash soundwave rifles, laser cannons, and grenades to light up the battlefield, upgrade your gear, and fight deeper into the horde.

Every shot reveals the world—every wave pushes your limits.

title: Underwater Survival
description:
Dive Into a Mysterious and Beautiful Underwater World
Welcome to an unforgettable underwater survival adventure where exploration, discovery, and survival come together in a stunning ocean environment. Dive deep into a vibrant and mysterious sea filled with hidden secrets, breathtaking visuals, and endless possibilities.

title: Granny 3 Return the School
description: The Granny Series continues with Granny 3: Return to the School. As Granny and Slendrina pursue you, you must discover the ammunition-filled pistol and all the keys to the classrooms of the deserted school. Entering the classroom, you'll find a solitary desk labeled "Granny" and the necessary keys to unlock the closed door.

title: Lemonade Tycoon Idle
description: Tap your way from a humble lemonade stand to a global empire! Serve customers, unlock upgrades, hire staff, and expand across the world. With a dynamic day/night cycle and relaxing lo-fi music, this is the ultimate idle lemonade experience.

title: Block Blast 2048
description: Block Blast 2048 is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you merge blocks with the same number to create higher values. Keep merging to boost your score and face increasing challenges. How far can you go? Can you reach the ultimate block? Play now and test your puzzle skills!

title: Buckshot Roulette
description: Do you dare to bet your life on an exciting roulette wheel showdown? Buckshot Roulette is a gun simulator that combines strategy, shooting and survival. Instead of a pistol, a powerful shotgun was used. Every pull of the trigger is a choice of fate. The winner lives, the loser dies. You will begin a Turn-Based shooting roulette game. Each round will have a fixed number of bullets and blanks.

title: Sid & Ginny Y2K Glam Clash
description: Welcome to the Y2K style fashion world! Two charismatic heroines are waiting for you, ready to try on fashion trends from the 2000s. Create spectacular makeup for them with lip gloss, shining shadows and glossy skin; choose stylish hairstyles - from smooth straight hair to playful ponytails and fashionable hairpins. Experiment with low-cut jeans, crop tops, mini skirts, shiny fabrics, and bold combinations. Complete the resulting image with iconic accessories of those years.

title: Construction Simulator
description: Ready to build big and drive even bigger. Construction Simulator brings you into the most realistic world of construction driving simulation. Designed for boys who love mechanics, speed and challenges.

title: Paws Off My Clues!
description:
Explore unique locations filled with hidden objects and unexpected mysteries. From sunny beaches to the ancient ruins of Persia, every corner of this fluffy world comes to life as you hunt for hidden treasures.

Watch as the cats go about their lives, adding charm and humor to the atmosphere, while you search through their delightful mess. Solve puzzles, progress through levels, and become the ultimate hidden object master!

title: Car Stunt Racing 3D
description: Car Stunt Racing 3D is a fun racing game. Open this incredibly entertaining car racing mobile game and prepare yourself to engage in all kinds of thrilling races. Place your fingers on the ground and get ready for the unexpected. You will never know what you will encounter when making your next turn. Collect energy and money, evade opponents, and join us to experience the thrill of speed and excitement! We wish you a joyful gameplay experience!

title: Obby Survive Parkour
description:
Obby Survivor Parkour is a fast-paced 3D parkour and escape game designed for players who trust their reflexes. You will test both your speed and balance skills while trying to survive in the obstacle filled course!

Each section is full of new traps and platforms that will challenge you even more. Try to survive tsunami waves, obstacle courses, lava attacks, snowball storms and red light green light game and reach the finish line.  Can you be one of the few who can reach the end of the course?

title: Celebrity E-Girl Vibes
description: Step into the world of edgy street style with Celebrity E-Girl Vibes!  This game lets you dress up celebrities in the bold, trendy looks that define E-Girl fashion. Experiment with colorful hairstyles, graphic eyeliner, oversized hoodies, crop tops, ripped jeans, plaid skirts, chokers, and statement accessories. Pair each look with vibrant makeup and nail polish to complete the vibe.

title: Underwater Survival Deep Dive
description: This is an underwater adventure game set on an alien ocean planet. You'll encounter a vast open world filled with wonders and dangers! Survival in this alien oceanic world demands quick thinking and resourcefulness. Your ship is your raft.

title: Memory Match Magic
description: Dive into the enchanting world of "Memory Match Magic," a delightful casual game that challenges your memory and takes you on a magical journey of matching pairs! Immerse yourself in a whimsical realm filled with colorful cards, charming animations.

title: Barbee Met Gala Transformation
description: Barbee and her friends have a big night ahead—the Met Gala! It’s your job to help each of them get dressed up and feel amazing. Whether someone’s into bold colors or classic glam, you get to style their look from head to toe and make sure they’re ready to walk the red carpet.

title: Legend of Dragon Hunt
description:
Legend Of Dragon Hunt is a clicker game. Players control a skeleton hero to eliminate invading monsters, gain resources/skills, and defeat bosses.
Features: light-hearted 2D cartoon style, joystick control, auto-shooting.
Systems: Pet, Player Upgrade, Sign-in, Weapon, Weapon Fusion, Idle.

title: Ball Craze Sort
description:
Ball Craze Sort is a fun, relaxing, and addictive puzzle game where your goal is to sort colorful balls into the correct order. What starts as a simple task quickly turns into a brain-teasing challenge as more colors and tubes are introduced.
Ball Craze Sort is the perfect game to unwind or mentally recharge. Whether you’re looking to relax for a few minutes or challenge your logic skills for hours, this game offers the ideal balance between fun and focus.

title: Around Elbrus
description: In the game “Around Elbrus”, the player controls a character who rushes down Mount Elbrus. The goal of the game is to collect all the coins and overcome various obstacles such as rocks, cliffs and avalanches. The game features beautiful graphics and addictive gameplay and is suitable for players of all ages.

title: G Wagon City Driver
description: Dive into city driving with four game modes. Navigate busy morning streets, managing fuel and realistic traffic. Venture beyond the city to tackle rugged offroad terrain. Stunning morning graphics bring the city and landscapes to life, while unpredictable pedestrians and police chases add excitement. Customize your G-Wagon's look and performance, and enjoy the ride with your loyal dog. Whether evading cops or exploring trails, G-Wagon City Driver offers a thrilling experience.

title: Planet Takeover
description: take command of your interstellar empire and set out to conquer the entire galaxy! Forge strategic alliances that can be either your greatest asset or, under the cover of darkness.

title: Axe Throw
description:
Ready to test your precision? Welcome to Axe Throw, the ultimate test of aim and timing. The rules are simple, but the challenge is endless. You have one goal: Break the target.

But be careful—the path to victory is rigged with danger. Explosive bombs are moving, and blocking your way. One wrong move, and it's game over!

title: Power Light
description: Move the tiles around until the power can flow freely to the light bulb. Power up the light bulb to complete each level in this fun online puzzle game

title: Draw To Smash!
description:
Draw To Smash — a logic puzzle game in which you should draw a line, scribbles, figures or doodles to smash all the bad eggs.

Draw To Smash is an amusing logic game that will test your IQ and raise your intellectual abilities to a new level. Plan every step, estimate a possible outcome and build tactical strategies. Solve logical puzzles, pass interesting levels and open bonus levels.

title: Drift Donut
description: Drift into action with this exhilarating 3D car drifting game! Master the art of drifting as you take control of a variety of cars and navigate through uniquely designed donut-shaped roads. The challenge is simple: click or tap to start drifting and keep your car on the road to earn points. With every donut road you clear, your score increases, challenging you to push your drifting skills to the limit.

title: Crime Theft Gangster Paradise
description: Crime Theft Gangster Paradise is an action-packed gaming experience set in the neon-lit streets of Las Vegas. Players become ruthless gangsters, armed with a vast array of weapons. Engage in intense shootouts while collecting valuable loot

title: Northern Lights - the secret of the forest
description:
A new hit for fans of the Match 3 game genre!

The Scientist Cat is already hiding items throughout the mysterious forest so you can enjoy finding things and earn as many emeralds as possible. The cat is happy to have new guests!

title: Cannon Blast - The Last Stand
description: You are in control of a cannon and the enemy army is marching towards you. You have to improve your skills, collect coins to buy upgrades, and never retreat because this is The Last Stand.

title: Bloon Pop
description:
Bloon Pop is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you rotate the frame to pop colorful balloons using a spinning saw!
Use gravity and timing to guide all the balloons toward the blades and watch them burst into vibrant splashes of color.
With bright visuals and relaxing gameplay, Bloon Pop offers satisfying fun for players of all ages. Can you pop them all?

title: High Heels 2
description: Stack rider new run adventure game with high heels, swipe to collect heels and make tall stack heels, and cross bricks and reach the destination. Have a good time.

title: Toilet Roll
description: Remember the fun of unrolling toilet paper as a kid? Now relive that joy in a fast-paced game. Unwind as many rolls as you can in one minute, but be careful not to tear the paper—it costs valuable time. Earn points for upgrades. Play Toilet Roll for free and let your inner child loose!

title: Fruit Balls: Juicy Fusion
description:
Discover the exciting world of juicy fruits! The task is simple: connect identical fruits to create ever larger and tastier associations, heading towards the treasured watermelon.

- Click on the field
- Connect identical fruits
- Create combinations to get bigger fruits.
- Reach the last level
- Don't let the container overfill
- Earn money for new skins and try to pass with them ???

genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

description: Dive into Tropical Merge, the ultimate merge game where you can create your tropical paradise! Immerse yourself in a vibrant world as you match and combine resources in three groups to craft exciting new items.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game
