description: Only Up Parkour 2! is an exciting arcade game in which you have to overcome obstacles and conquer heights of 500M. Inspired by the popular game Your task is to guide the character through a vertical labyrinth full of various obstacles. You must react quickly, jump accurately and climb up dexterously to avoid crashing into obstacles and falling down. As you progress through the various levels, you will encounter increasing difficulty and new challenges such as Jumping platforms and obstacles.

title: Crazy Zoo Swipe - Match 3 Puzzle Game
description: Welcome to the Crazy Zoo. Connect the same animals here to eliminate them. The more you connect, the greater the chance of obtaining powerful props. If you encounter a difficult level after that, use it wisely to let it burst out with unimaginable magic. Energy light waves, successfully pass the level!

title: Domino Adventure
description: Discover three match durations to suit your style. Showcase your skills and logic in each round, and use strategic moves to outplay your opponents. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts seeking endless fun and challenges.

title: Steal Brainrot Monsters!
description:
Step into a world of fun, charm, and Italian flair with Buy Cute and Funny Animals! From the tiny and delightful Nubini Pizzanini to the rare and majestic Tralalelo Tralala and the playful Los Tralalelitos, there’s no shortage of adorable creatures to collect.

Build your very own cozy base, place your animals in it, and make them feel right at home. In return, they’ll reward you with coins, which you can use to unlock even more animals and exciting upgrades.

title: Mahjong Adventure: World Quest
description:
Welcome traveler, to the most epic quest of all time! Test your Mahjong skills as you journey across the world.

It's time to put everything on the line as you challenge these intriguing yet challenging levels. Complete the quest and witness the wonders of the world.

How quickly can you match the Mahjong tiles? Come play now and let's find out!

title: Xytrian Runner
description: Xytrian is an endless flight runner where you pilot a spaceship through a dangerous course. Dodge obstacles, score points, and survive as long as you can! Click to control your shuttle and hit the timing perfectly! Only precise altitude changes will let you overcome the obstacles ahead.

title: Memoji
description: Match pairs of emojis and word cards to uncover and learn about a significant historical event from around the world each day.

title: End Of World
description:
There are only 337 coins left in the world, collect them faster than the rest

You will appear in a post-apocalyptic world 

With coins, you can unlock unique items in the world, but you'll have to find them first

Summoning waves you can get even more coins
if you don't let the monsters get close to you

By completing the race, you will be able to convert your achievements into victory points and buy a unique incredibly powerful weapon!

And remember, you need to collect all the coins!

title: Doors Awakening
description: This is a challenging puzzle-solving online game.  This game has wonderful 3D graphics enabling you to explore the handcrafted levels. The fascinating visual effects, realistic atmosphere, and natural camera controls will keep you returning for more. If you'd prefer puzzle games, don't miss this wonderful challenge.

title: Tap Car
description:
Unveil stunning car masterpieces by solving image puzzles. Every tap reveals more of the picture—can you uncover them all? A must-play for car enthusiasts and puzzle lovers alike!

Would you like a few more variations depending on the tone you're aiming for (like more casual, exciting, or elegant)?

title: Beach Soccer
description: Immerse yourself in a fun-filled beach adventure where your goal is to aim and shoot the ball into the goal while collecting starfish for maximum points. With over 20 challenging levels, you'll need to think strategically to navigate obstacles like crabs and sandcastles. Enjoy a vibrant beach setting complete with golden sand, coconut trees, and a soothing soundtrack.

title: Block Cut Cleaner
description: An original block puzzle where the field is filled with triangle blocks! Pull out your shapes and place them on the field to clear at 100%. But be careful: each piece you place can create new blocks! Use smart boosters to turn the tide: refresh your inventory, remove three random triangles or place a "clean" square that doesn't leave blocks behind. Plan your strategy to clear the board completely!

title: Avenger Guard
description: Dark forces have destroyed your homeland—rise as the Avenger Guard! Merge heroes to unlock power, fortify defenses, and take vengeance. Lead your legendary squad to repel waves of enemies, upgrade through fusion, and reclaim what’s yours. Will you be the last line of defense?

title: Superwings ColorSwitch
description: Guide Mini Super Pet Golden Boy through space avoiding all the traps to move forward. Dodge circles, barriers, boxes, and all kinds of obstacles

title: BLOCK MATCH 8x8
description:
Place blocks to form vertical or horizontal rows and erase the target blocks!
The game is over when no more blocks can be placed or there are no moves left.

title: Sort Parking
description: Sort cars by type. You cannot park in a full parking lot. Cars cannot be placed in front of different types. You can increase the number of car models with coins available in the game. If you clear many stages, you will get pieces for the background. When pieces of the same type are matched, the background is completed and the background can be changed.

title: Avatar Master - Fix Up Face
description: Creative and unique puzzle. Fix your avatar's face. Collect all the puzzles of beautiful characters. Avatars from anime to Vikings from cute girls to tough knights. Have a fun and train your brain, memory and logic. Meditative and relaxing game play.

title: Train Master
description: All aboard for an exciting ride in Train Master! Tap and hold to control your train, race through stunning tracks, pick up passengers, and dodge obstacles. Navigate bustling cities and peaceful countryside as you master the tracks, upgrade your train, and become the ultimate conductor. Simple controls, thrilling challenges, and endless fun await. Start your adventure now!

title: DOP: Draw One Part
description:
► Can you see what’s missing? 

What a pretty picture, but don’t you get the nagging feeling that something’s not quite right? What’s the final touch that will make the image complete? 

Engage your brain, your imagination and your artistic talents to identify the missing element and add it to the drawing in this delightful puzzle game that will get you thinking and make you smile time and time again.

title: Dynamons Connect
description:
Dive into the exciting world of Dynamons Connect! This fun and engaging game with adorable, colorful characters helps improve focus and visual perception.
Match identical tiles by connecting them with a path that has no more than two turns to clear the board. With endless levels, the challenge never stops!

title: Pick Brainrot: 3D Battle
description: Choose one of two Brainrots, transform into them, and engage in intense battles with other players. Defeat opponents and unlock new abilities: a Brainrot morph, unique weapons, and powerful abilities. Every battle is a chance to prove yourself! At level 5, you'll unlock a protective shield, and at level 10, you'll unlock slow-motion , which will give you a huge advantage in battle. Earn titles for your victories, from "Noob" to a true "Pro"!

title: 3Dash
description: 3Dash is a fast-paced 3D rhythm platformer inspired by Geometry Dash—dash, jump, and flip through dizzying, rotating tracks while keeping perfect time. Tackle six hand-crafted levels, then build your own with the level editor for endless replay

title: Funny Walk Fail Run
description: Funny Walk Fail Run is a fun-filled arcade action game with funny and magical gameplay! You will control a villain in the game to do challenges. But don't expect him to walk steadily, because he always falls and bumps in all sorts of funny positions! Your job is to help him navigate each step of the shaky road.

title: Candy Jewels
description: It is a candy-filled puzzle adventure full of surprises! Match candies, break chests and collect coins as you progress through countless levels. Complete fun events like Time Attack or Coin Catch and use boosters to overcome tricky obstacles even faster!

title: Blocks Stack Rush
description: Enjoy an addictive stacking adventure. In Blocks Stack Rush, you’ll control a little block character running and begin a fun pixelated journey. Collect blocks, stack them high and race against time to build the perfect picture. You need to align each block and keep putting together the complete picture.

title: Farm Block
description: Farm Block is an engaging farm-themed puzzle game where players slide adorable animal blocks to free them from the farm. Test your strategic thinking and enjoy the charming countryside setting! With its mix of puzzle-solving and elimination mechanics, Farm Block offers a fun and rewarding challenge for all ages.

title: Clean The Floor
description:
The house is so dirty. We need a cleaner ASAP.
Your job is to clean the floor spotless and make the owner satisfied as much as possible.
Use your vacuum machine to wipe out the dirt, and trash on the floor and make them clean again

title: Makeup Trends: Then And Now
description: Step into the exciting world of makeup transformations with  Makeup Trends: Then And Now! Join influencer Kiki as you explore the evolution of beauty trends from the early 2000s to 2024. Experiment with y2k-VSCO and emo-euphoria dark looks, mixing vibrant eyeshadows, bold lip colors, and edgy styles. Customize unique hairstyles and accessories to complete your makeup looks. With endless possibilities to mix and match, become a beauty trendsetter in this fun and engaging game for girls.

title: Vortex io
description:
Play Vortex.io for free! Swallow everything in your path and become the biggest vortex in this fast-paced io game.

Vortex.io is a competitive .io game where you control a growing vortex that can swallow objects, vehicles, and even other players. As you absorb more items, your size increases, making you more powerful in the arena. The game features smooth controls and intense gameplay, requiring quick reflexes and smart movement to survive and dominate your rivals in real time.

title: Fruit Match Juicy Puzzle
description: Fruit Match Juicy Puzzle is an irresistibly fun puzzle casual game that bursts with juicy visuals and addictive gameplay! A brilliant combination of puzzle and match mechanics. From the moment you start, you’ll be hooked on its satisfying matching mechanics and clever level design.

title: Strongblade
description:
Your favorite gameplay: match-3 puzzle game with building elements! Play three-in-a-row and set up impressive campgrounds!
Hundreds of varied levels with incredible boosters and explosive combinations!
Lots of game events and tough challenges! Complete exciting quests to upgrade your camp!
Atmospheric fantasy world: detailed animations, picturesque landscapes and charming characters!
Interesting characters who are ready to become your friends and join your journey!

title: Fashionista Christmas Eve Party
description: Indulge in the Fashionista Christmas Eve Party extravaganza! Discover glamorous holiday ensembles, festive accessories, and the perfect blend of chic for a stylish celebration. Join the fashion-forward festivities and elevate your Christmas Eve style to new heights. Unwrap the magic of the season with Fashionista, where every outfit is a statement and every moment is a fashion triumph. Let the glamour of Christmas Eve unfold.

title: Cosmo Void
description: Enter the dazzling void of space where only sharp reflexes and split-second decisions can lead you to victory. Cosmo Void is a high-speed action runner where your space journey becomes more intense with every level. Face shifting obstacles, sudden turns, and blinding speed as you pilot your cosmic vessel through an ever-evolving space labyrinth.

title: Devil Dash
description: Level Devil Dash is ready to break the ultimate limit within your inner demon rage! Prepare for a hellish journey that demands top-notch improvisation skills and extreme patience. You will embark on an adventure through interconnected worlds, tightly linked to one another.

title: Unicorn Find The Differences
description: Unicorn Find The Differences is a magical spot-the-difference game designed to test your observation skills and bring a bit of fantasy into your day! Each level offers beautifully crafted images with subtle differences that make every game exciting and engaging. Perfect for both kids and adults, this game is a delightful way to relax, challenge your attention to detail, and enjoy charming unicorn illustrations. See if you can spot all the differences and reach the next level of mythical fun!

title: Fury Tanks
description: Beyond the hills and forests, war waits in silence. When it starts, it’s you, your tank and the enemy in your sights. Build your armor, power up your cannon and let instinct guide your aim. When the ground shakes, make sure it’s because you fired first.

title: Hill Station Bus Simulator
description: "Hill Station Bus Simulator" invites players to step into the shoes of a skilled bus driver navigating the challenging terrains of picturesque hill stations. As the primary protagonist, your mission is to efficiently transport passengers through winding roads, steep ascents, and captivating landscapes, while managing a thriving bus service. The game offers an engaging blend of realistic driving simulation, strategic decision-making, and immersive experiences.

title: Farm: Merge Harvest
description: Transform your land into a beautiful farming haven. Start with a small plot and grow it by merging crops, designing structures and unlocking new areas. The more you build, the more surprises await, bringing new rewards and adventures at every stage!

title: What a walk
description: Whatawalk! silly walking with wobbly legsWhatawalk! is a highly addictive classical game. Even if you've never heard of it before, play it just once and you'll be hooked.

title: Ninja Spell Match
description: Ninja Spell Match is a fast-paced blend of match-3 puzzling and ninja action. Connect tiles to charge up your attacks and unleash devastating moves against waves of enemies. With each level, the challenge grows tougher as you fight your way through 30 unique stages packed with traps, puzzles, and rival ninjas. Think fast, match smart, and strike hard—your reflexes and strategy are the only way to survive.

title: Maze Cube 2048
description:
Dive into a world of challenging puzzles that test your strategic skills!
Become a true maze master! To conquer each level, you must carefully think ahead and plan your moves. The puzzles start easy, but watch out each new maze brings a greater challenge.

title: Wheel in the face
description:
Jump behind the wheel of a furious combat vehicle and rush into battle! Lightning-fast battles await you in closed arenas: ram enemies, dodge traps, use deadly weapons and win deadly fights.

Choose your style: cut your opponents with a sword, shoot them with a shotgun or burn them to the ground with a flamethrower!

Upgrade cars, weapons and wheels, earn money and raise your rank.

title: Combinations Daily
description: Connect the tiles, make combinations and experience the ultimate puzzle adventure. Come back everyday for new challenges and maintain your monthly streaks!

title: Labubu and Treasures: Fun Adventure
description: Collect bright combinations, pass hundreds of levels together with amazing characters from the Labubu universe! In this exciting Match-3 puzzle you will find bright adventures, interesting puzzles and fluffy magic.

title: Ball Paint 3D
description: Ball Paint 3D is a relaxing, simple, and fun game for kids, free online. You only have to find the balls of the same color within the limited number of balls given to you to pass the game, with beautiful 3D graphics to give you the best gaming experience. It's a battle of the brains, do you dare to challenge?

title: Home Run Boy
description:
There is a boy who wants to become a home run king.
He's been practicing his batting and his dream is to hit the ball to the end of the world.
Hit the ball, build up your strength, and hit it farther and farther!

title: Farm Block Puzzle
description: This is the perfect game to satisfy your craving for a logical tetris-inspired game with a fresh spin on it. The countryside aesthetic will capture your attention with its beautiful graphics and lovely music.

title: HexaMatch
description:
HexaMatch – The Ultimate Number Puzzle!
Swipe and sort tiles into the empty slot to solve addictive hexa puzzles. With progressive difficulty, unique gameplay, and a fresh twist on classic number games, HexaMatch is perfect for all ages. Train your brain, relax your mind, and enjoy endless fun with this simple yet challenging merge hexa puzzle!

title: Blast Cubes
description: Blast Cubes is an addictive puzzle game where players strategically place cubes on a grid. When cubes align in horizontal or vertical rows, they explode, triggering an exciting chain reaction! After the explosion, characters of the same color as the exploded cube emerge and move towards vehicles of the same color waiting at the top. Once the vehicles are filled, new ones appear, continuing the cycle.

title: Tap 3D Blocks
description: Layers upon layers of dice await your skillful touch. Some puzzles ask you to think. This one dares you to see the whole picture. Flip, rotate and reveal new tiles as you uncover unexpected paths. Boosters lend a hand, but the strategy is all yours.

title: Suika Kawaii Cat Merge game
description: The game is a fun, puzzle-based merging game where players control a dropper that releases animals onto the field. Players must carefully move the dropper to align and drop matching animals. When two of the same type collide, they merge into a higher-level animal. The goal is to keep merging and progressing to create new animals. Special buttons offer abilities like shaking the container or merging random animals, adding strategy and excitement to the gameplay.

title: Pixel Fun Color By Number
description: Pixel Fun - Color By Number is a fun coloring game that lets you bring pixel art to life. With casual number-based instructions, you’ll fill in each pixel square to reveal stunning artwork.Each image is divided into tiny pixels. Each is assigned a number that corresponds to a color. For example, click on the city scene to fill in color and light up the street.

title: Grocery Shop: Supermarket Game
description: Run and manage your own supermarket in this engaging simulation game. Stock shelves, serve customers, manage inventory, and expand your store to build a successful grocery business. Handle the rush of customers while keeping products organized and priced competitively to maximize profits.

title: Cannon Shooter
description: Cannon Shooter is an exciting arcade shooter where you can have endless shooting fun in fast-paced combat! You will control a cannonball firing hordes of heroic characters, facing many enemies. A quick click to launch more heroes and help you generate more heroes through the digital gate.

title: Epic Stunts PvP 3D
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning muscle car through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: K-Pop Hunters Valentine Style
description: K-Pop Hunters Valentine Style brings romance, fashion, and K-pop glamour together in one stylish dress-up experience. Help your favorite K-pop hunters transform their looks for Valentine’s Day with stunning outfits, flawless makeup, and charming accessories.

title: Cookie monster
description: What more could you ask for?! Puzzle, brain teaser, monsters, snacks...wait what? That's right MONSTERS and SNACKS! Feed the hungry monsters snacks to pass the level! You have to make sure all the snacks get into the monster's mouth though or you will see a sad face! Let's keep these monsters happy! If you like the game, leave us a review! That will help us continue to bring you many more challenging levels, new monsters, maybe some new twizzler lines.

title: Geometry Vibes X-Ball
description:
Geometry Vibes X-Ball is ready to give you a completely different gaming experience! After the first game of the series, interactive new levels, challenge section and completely new store are waiting for you in X-Ball mode. 

Start your new adventure now in Geometry Vibes X-Ball game where you will find yourself avoiding obstacles, traps and gears in each level!

title: Flower Collection
description: Flower Collection is a poetic casual adventure game where players explore a beautiful natural world to collect various rare and beautiful flowers. The game combines exploration, collection, and light puzzle elements to bring players a peaceful and delightful gaming experience.

title: Toy Cars: 3D Racing
description: Jump into the car and participate in this racing experience. Compete with other racers, participate in various challenges and time-limited events. Prepare your car and drift. Upgrade your carriage. The engine, tires and chassis improve the overall performance of your car.

title: Robot Band - Find the Differences
description:
Spot all the differences you can find in the pictures of these lively robots playing their instruments and do it fast!
Try to find all the differences in each picture before the time runs out. Be careful though: Do not touch the screen randomly trying to catch all the differences this way!
If you touch the screen 5 times without touching one of the differences is game over!

title: Tip Tap!
description:
Get ready for a challenging and fun physics-based skill game where your goal is simple: move either the dynamic plate or the ball to reach the emoji smiley and complete the level without falling off the edge?

Key Features
-50+ skill-challenging levels that ramp up in difficulty as you progress
-Physics-based gameplay that tests your precision and timing
-Dynamic controls: move the plate or the ball to reach the goal

title: Color Sort Puzzle
description: Spend your time wisely, relaxing and training your mind all at once! Put the water in the most strategic flask and enjoy when everything falls into place.

title: Hide And Seek Horror Escape
description: Hide And Seek: Horror Escape is an asymmetric horror escape game. Abandoned schools and haunted hospitals, here's a lot of hidden secrets and treasures are waiting to be discovered. During the game, there are two identities for you to choose, hide or seek?

title: Crush it ALL!
description: Take on an exciting journey in Crush it all, a fun mobile game where you guide a lively anvil. Flip and jump to squish fruits, bottles, emojis, and more on your way to the finish line. Watch out for dangerous fire and water, one wrong move, and it’s game over! Can you crush through the chaos and reach the end safely? Test your skills in this fast and addictive challenge!

title: My Happy farm
description: Welcome to farm land game – the ultimate farming adventure that brings the beauty of rural life, the challenge of resource management, and the excitement of running your very own farm straight to your browser. The game is not just about clicking and waiting; it’s about strategy, timing, and smart decisions. Do you invest in farms first or focus on crops? Should you expand your land or upgrade your equipment? Every choice matters.

title: Find the Differences Cars
description: In this game Find the Differences Cars you need to keep locate differences between the two pictures in the limited amount of time given to play each time! To play, use your mouse as control. Make sure that you don’t make a mistake more than three times because that will make you fail. One minute is the total time you will play through the 20 levels in this game! In each level you have seven differences. Good luck!

title: Yummy Trails
description: Can you help the hungry snake navigate the tastiest trail of all? The path may be tricky, but the reward is delicious. Test your brain and relax.

title: Geometry Open World
description: Geometry Open World is a fast-paced 2D action game where players pilot a ship through perilous obstacles, engage in thrilling battles against diverse enemies, and take on epic boss fights. With a vibrant and dynamic open world, strategic upgrades, and powerful abilities, you can chart your own path to triumph. Will you conquer the challenges, defeat the bosses, and rise to become the ultimate champion in this open-world geometric action adventure?

title: Arcade Rope
description:
Swing between platforms in Arcade Rope! Play free and online in this rope-swinging adventure.
Arcade Rope is a fast-paced and addictive skill game where your goal is to swing from platform to platform using a rope. Perfectly time your swings to avoid falling into the abyss and see how far you can go. The gameplay is simple yet challenging, making it ideal for quick play sessions. Stay alert, react quickly, and master the art of swinging to survive longer.

title: Draw The Weapon
description: Draw The Weapon is a free online action and drawing game for boys played on PuzzleGame. The game is divided into two parts. First, you need to draw your weapons with limited ink. Next, enter the battlefield, and then shoot the enemy down the cliff with weapons to win the battle. In addition to a variety of weapons, we also provide wonderful skins for you, Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop are playable!

title: Ellie's Recipe: Dubai Chocolate Bar
description: Whip up luxury in Ellie’s Recipe: Dubai Chocolate Bar! Help Ellie create rich, decadent chocolate treats in this fun, interactive cooking game. Gather ingredients, prepare molds, make gourmet fillings, and craft elegant chocolate bars with Dubai flair. Unlock stylish outfits for Ellie and enjoy hands-on cooking fun with real kitchen actions. From mixing to decorating, every step is sweet! Play now and become a luxury dessert pro with Ellie!

title: Deform It
description:
Deform It is a game about deforming objects. There are 13 different ball options and 14 levels in total. Set in space, this game has 3 game modes.
-Level Mode
-Free Deform Mode
-Antigravity Mode

title: Candy Doll Dress Up
description: Candy Doll Dress Up is a wonderful fashion adventure! Step into a world of fashion magic, where you’re the ultimate stylist for your very own princess doll. There are tons of different styles of clothes here to help you create the doll. You can customize a doll from scratch—pick hair, make, and dress to scream your style.

title: Screw Nuts & Bolts: Wood Solve
description: Embark on a Brain-Twisting Journey with Screw Nuts & Bolts: Wood Solve, an exceptional wood puzzle game about nuts and bolts to test your IQ brain power. For nuts and bolts lovers who likes challenge and innovative gameplay, the right game for you - the ultimate puzzle game - is here.

title: Checkers
description:
Immerse yourself in classic checkers on the go! 
Enjoy strategic moves, challenging AI, and hot-seat multiplayer fun in this classic checkers game!
Dive into the timeless fun of Checkers! Experience sleek design, smart AI opponent, and thrilling hot-seat multiplayer matches in this classic board game. Master strategy and make every move count!

title: Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up
description:
In Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up, you’re dressing up your doll and getting her ready to go live. Pick from different styles—she can look like a fairy, wear chill street clothes, or go for a beach outfit. When you’re done, she jumps on the stream and starts showing off her look.

You can mess with her hair, add makeup, and try out accessories. There’s also a battle mode where you go up against other players to see who styled it best.

title: Puzzle Fever
description: A vibrant new puzzle game featuring colorful hexagons! This straightforward yet engaging game offers a plethora of hues. Simply drag the blocks to navigate, fill the gameboard, and accumulate coins and points! Puzzle Fever caters to players of all skill levels, providing unique levels across various difficulties, from Basic to Master.

title: Emoji Frenzy
description:
Test your reflexes and knowledge in this fast-paced emoji matching game! 
Tap the correct emoji before time runs out, build streaks, and unlock new themes. Simple to play, hard to master!

title: Space Strike: Galaxy Shooter
description:
Space Strike is an arcade galactic shooter 2D. Experience adrenaline-pumping aerial combat and battle your enemies in classic space combat!

Join  Space Strike today and become an ace pilot defending and liberating various space planets from waves of enemies! Take control of a spaceship in a galactic shooter, shoot down every group of aliens and prevent enemy forces from taking over the entire galaxy!

title: Brain Test: One Line Draw Puzzle
description: In this engaging one-line puzzle game, challenge your brain by drawing shapes in a single stroke without lifting your finger. Each level presents a unique shape that must be drawn in one continuous line, testing your logic and creativity. With increasing difficulty, you’ll need to plan your moves carefully to solve each puzzle. Perfect for players of all ages, this game offers hours of fun while improving problem-solving skills. Can you master the art of drawing each shape in one go?

title: Superhero Phone Simulator
description: Explore action-packed mini-games, customize your hero, and test your skills in fun challenges. Whether you enjoy racing, creativity, or exciting adventures, this app has everything you need for endless fun!

title: Country Life Meadows
description: Country Life Meadows is a farming adventure game where you turn a humble patch of land into a thriving estate. Cultivate crops, expand your business, and manage a skilled team.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Meme Wars
description: MeMe Wars is a strategy battler with US-style Shanhaijing flair. Build a quirky hero lineup with unique roles and stats. Place them on the board for max power, adapt to new foes each stage, and win.

title: Daring Jack
description:
Jack, an adventurer, was flying over the sea in his small aircraft. When he reached a jungle island, his aircraft's engine failed and he lost control. He escaped from the crashing aircraft, landed safely on the island, and now must find a boat to leave.

He knows of the old boathouse on the island but is uncertain how to reach it. Guide him through the jungle to the boathouse. Help him gather items for survival, focusing on securing food and shelter while navigating the challenging terrain.

title: Bus Driver Simulator 3D
description:
Bus Driver Simulator 3D is a bus simulator in which you will be able to drive different types of buses traveling around different parts of the world including Los Angeles, Berlin, Rome, Alaska and so on.

Each scenario in Bus Driver Simulator 3D has special characteristics. So, for example, in Alaska you will be driving on snowy tundra, and other cars will not be very much, but on the city highway in Los Angeles the traffic will be more intense.

title: Spa empire
description:
? BUILD YOUR DREAM SPA EMPIRE

Have you ever dreamed of running the ultimate spa, offering everything from soothing massages to exciting makeovers? Step into My Spa Empire, the idle arcade game where you dye hair, create stunning hair color makeovers and manage a bustling spa filled with exciting treatments. Design, upgrade, and expand your spa into the ultimate relaxation haven for your guests.

title: Freddys Nightmares Return Horror New Year
description:
Immerse yourself in this 3D game there's no need to fear the monster Freddy. To familiarize yourself with the area, play the escape mode. You'll find yourself in a mysterious, forgotten city on New Year's Eve, with snow making escape difficult. Go out of there as quickly as possible and see how far you can go.

Freddy Krueger and his snowman minions will relentlessly pursue and attack you in the second game mode, but you have the option to bring weapons to help you destroy them.

title: Match Tile Royal Family
description: Play an addictive brain challenge in Match Tile Royal Family. This is not just another match puzzle game. It’s a thrilling mix of logic, strategy, and quick thinking. Your goal is simple yet exciting: match tiles of the same design to clear the board. Unlock levels and rescue the royal family from tricky traps. Eliminate blocks, balls, and other objects in a limited number of moves. You can also use power-ups to quickly clear blocks or temporarily freeze obstacles.

title: Pull The Thread - Puzzle
description: Unwind your mind with Pull The Thread - Puzzle, a captivating HTML5 game that challenges your logic and creativity! In this fun puzzle game, your task is to stretch a thread between all the screws on the screen, creating intricate patterns while solving each level. As the puzzles grow more complex, your problem-solving skills will be put to the test. With simple controls, engaging gameplay, and a satisfying sense of accomplishment.

title: Infantry Attack Battle 3D FPS
description: Soldier! Stop playing the escape game! The third world war is here, and the mission is waiting for you! The enemy is attacking our country, and we count on you to protect it, so grab your weapon and prepare to fight! Easy control to aim and shoot the enemy, finish each task to win the ultimate victory!

title: Tricky Life
description:
Welcome to Tricky Life, the funniest brain test puzzle game ever made!
Here, logic meets laughter every level is designed to make you giggle, think twice, and smile when you finally find the answer.

title: Bloxd.io
description: Bloxd.io is an IO adventure game with Minecraft-style visuals where you can navigate obstacle courses, gather resources, craft tools, battle other players, and much more. With game modes ranging from parkour challenges and creative sandbox building to combat-based gameplay, there's something for every playstyle.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Push The Colors
description: Push the Color game features colorful squares, obstacles, and color gates. It is a 2-player casual game where you can find various costumes during the adventure. The goal is to get the cubes to the finish line and challenge the giant at the end. The more cubes you have, the more power you will possess. You can defeat the color monster by having many cubes. Make wise choices along the way and increase the number of cubes in your possession.

title: Pop Them!
description:
Link 3 or more emojis of the same color!
Link them in any direction to connect them all!
Reach the goal within the limited number of moves
Pop the bubbles around the boxes or evil emojis to destroy them
Use power-ups to accomplish your mission!

title: Hide And Seek Blue Monster
description: Enter a world full of mystery and fun. In Hide And Seek: Blue Monster, you will experience a unique hide-and-seek adventure. The game combines casual games with puzzle challenges. You should keep running away to prevent being caught by the blue monster, and when the blue monster is staring at you, hold stop in front of the fruit, in front of the coke, or front of the water glass, etc.

title: Sprunki Shooter 2025
description: Sprunki Shooter 2025 is a free to play online game that delivers exciting shooting action in a colorful and challenging world. Players must navigate through each level, clearing obstacles and defeating enemies to reach the exit. The goal is to complete all levels by unlocking the exit doors. To do this, players must shoot and collect all the scattered diamonds while avoiding or eliminating dangerous enemies along the way. Have fun!

title: Fish Out of Water!
description:
Dive into a thrilling adventure with Fish Out of Water, without ads or in-app purchases. A captivating game by Halfbrick Studios, the creators of Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride. Launch a group of brave fish pals into the sky and over the ocean, helping them travel far and bounce as much as possible!

Experience remastered graphics and audio and enjoy a rebalanced crystal unlocking system for a more rewarding experience.

title: Steam Sorter
description: Take control of a cute robot and get to work sorting industrial garbage! A dynamic puzzle game with a steampunk aesthetic.

title: Mafia Sniper Crime Shooting
description: Ready to become the coldest, deadliest sniper in the entire city? Mafia Sniper Crime Shooting is a FPS action shooting simulator where you complete high-risk missions. Use powerful guns to eliminate dangerous mafia targets.

title: Thread Match 2
description:
Thread Match 2 is a satisfying logic puzzle game that combines color matching, layered challenges, and calming embroidery visuals.

Solve clever thread puzzles by planning the correct order of moves and dismantling complex constructions. Each level challenges your brain with blocked and unlocked elements, where strategy and attention matter more than speed.

title: Doomsday Survival Rpg Shooter
description: Doomsday Survival Rpg Shooter is a 2D side-scrolling survival RPG shooting game. Zombies occupy the whole city. You need to recruit the last survivors to fight against zombies for a living. As humans, you need weapons, ammo, food, and medicines. Send your teammates to dispatch different buildings, go to complete the tasks in this fallen town. Time is your life, get out of the safe house and find resources!

title: Children Happy Farm DuDu
description: Hey there, little farmers in the making! Welcome to "Children Happy Farm DuDu"! This is an amazing casual simulator designed just for your kids. In this fun-filled farm world, you'll be the boss of your farm. The farm is full of cute animals like fluffy sheep, clucking chickens, and friendly cows. Your job is to take good care of them. Feed the animals, clean their shelters, and make sure they are happy.

title: Tile Adventure
description: A fun and satisfying tile-matching puzzle game! Match tiles in sets of three, clear the board, and enjoy a relaxing, brain-teasing experience. With smooth gameplay, colorful visuals, and levels that gradually increase in challenge, it’s perfect for anyone who loves casual puzzles. (Inspired by the classic Mahjong layout, but with a fresh, modern twist!)

title: Flow Block
description: Perfectly blends the classic Tetris gameplay with innovative sand flow mechanics. In the game, players not only follow the basic rules of traditional Tetris but also need to guide flowing sand particles to fill target areas.

title: Road Of Fury 4
description: Road Of Fury 4 is a scroller shooter game set in a world of post-apocalypse. Team-up with other nomads, upgrade cars, guns and super-powers and use your skills to fight through 30 levels and 3 bosses.

title: Hippo Supermarket
description: Meet Jack Ma, a cute hippo who dreams of opening his own supermarket. But he doesn't know how to do it. He needs your help to make his dream come true.In this fun and addictive game, you need to merge the same items to get higher-level items, and then sell them to earn money. The more money you make, the more you can help Jack Ma build his store.

title: Super Sprunki Clicker
description: Enjoy the Sprunki World in this clicker idle game. Immerse yourself in the beats and music simulation, create the band, and use the rewards to buy new upgrades and features. Break the screen touching the sprunkis, hire automatic clickers, social media features, instruments, and everything to become the Sprunki King.

title: Cocktailz
description: Thirsty? Make all sorts of cocktails in this refreshing Match-3 game! Excessive alcohol consumption is harmful to health, but you can play this game without moderation.

title: Race Time
description:
Race through thrilling tracks in your speedy car! Collect gears to charge up your booster and unleash a powerful speed burst.
Upgrade your car to unlock better performance and purchase the fastest vehicles to dominate the competition.
Use the super boost to knock opponents off the track, climb the leaderboard, and prove you're the ultimate racer.
Beat the clock and challenge your friends online!

title: Kings and Queens Match 3
description: Step into Kings and Queens Match 3, the enchanting third chapter of the royal Match-3 adventure! Match jewels, crowns, and other royal artifacts to progress through exciting levels. Use powerful boosters like bombs, hammers, and royal blasts to clear challenging boards. Unlock new parts of the kingdom as you enjoy stunning visuals and a charming soundtrack. Join the royal quest and discover treasure, challenge, and endless fun!

title: Grass Land
description: Grass Land is a vibrant exploration game that drops you into a sprawling world of thick greenery and hidden surprises. Take control of your grass cutter, uncover valuable resources beneath the overgrowth, and build up your base as you roam the fields. Stay sharp, move fast, and make the most of every patch of grass you find.

title: Hex Empire
description: Hex Empire is the action packed turn-based strategy game in which you will try and conquer all by domination of territory. You will start with a single nation, then your goal is to strategize and dominate the map by overruling countries attacking city by city with your armies and more importantly your winning tactics.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Hamster Combo IDLE
description: Upgrade your stock market hamster! A new Idle clicker, thanks to which you will learn a lot about cryptocurrency exchanges. Dig up the crypt and upgrade your hamster.

title: CraftMart
description:
Noob decided to go into business and open his own shop. And what do all the people of Minecraft want? That's right - to eat!

In Noob's shop you can always buy beet soup and bread! And also a lot of other food.

And now all the residents of Minecraft rushed to the best store! Help Noob to serve all the customers! No one should go hungry! :)

Build new fields for wheat and beets, get a cow and a chicken and expand the shop to the maximum assortment!

title: Samurai vs Yakuza - Beat Em Up
description: Yakuzas have captured hidden treasures and ruins. Take action to save the places from the yakuza using your samurai skills! Fight with yakuza in different locations. Destroy the yakuza using the swords and weapons found in the boxes. The future of the kingdom is in your hands. Prepare for the fight now and save the kingdom!

title: Brainrot Evolution
description: Welcome to the world of meme Italian animals - a dynamic arcade game where you control unique creatures, destroy the environment, gather resources, and unlock new animals. Your goal is to evolve and progress further, unlocking more and more unusual meme beasts. Help yourself with pets: each one provides advantages and strengthens your character. Explore levels, destroy objects, collect useful resources, and unlock the next stage of evolution.

title: Jetstream Escape
description: Play Jetstream Escape free online and dive into a high-speed browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install required. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home, making it perfect for quick breaks or long sessions. Race powerful boats, dodge coast guards, and outrun storms in this mobile-friendly arcade challenge. Designed for desktop and mobile players who love skill-based brain game style reflex tests, it’s a free online game built for pure,nonstop.

title: Cuddle Monster Fusion
description: Engage, Merge, and Challenge! Dive into a world of cuddly creatures where you combine identical monsters to evolve them and keep them from overflowing. But here’s the twist: when the same monsters collide, they transform into an entirely new, adorable creature. Can you merge your way to the ultimate fluffy beast?

title: Halloween Fruit Slice
description: Halloween Fruit Slice is a high-energy arcade action game set in a spooky Halloween world. Vivid fruits and devious traps streak across the screen in an instant. Your task is to slice as many fruits as possible with lightning speed, chaining spectacular combos and racking up points while dodging explosive bombs. Rich visuals, splashy juice effects, and eerie backdrops create a thrilling, immersive atmosphere. The tempo keeps rising, so every moment tests your reflexes and precision.

title: Merge Archer Defense
description: Merge Archer Defense is an archery game focused on castle defense. Are you prepared to fight for your king? Meld archers to create a formidable stickman archery team and battle to safeguard your fortress. Don't hesitate for another moment. Rise to the top as a merge master, vanquish the army of archers, and ascend as the greatest archery hero!

title: Counter Craft Sniper
description: Counter Craft Sniper is a first-person shooter where you step into the boots of an elite sniper sent to protect a city invaded by Minecraft mobs. Creepers, skeletons, and zombies have appeared in the middle of downtown, and only your precision and quick reflexes can stop them before the chaos spreads. Armed with your trusty sniper rifle, you must take position on rooftops and high vantage points to eliminate every hostile target that threatens the civilians below.

title: Fish Feeding
description: Nobody can stop you, but you are not the only fish in the sea: you will have to avoid the vicious sharks that wander in the deepest, darkest depths, looking for a nice little fish to eat! See how high you can score!

title: Smashdoll
description:
Smashdoll – Ragdoll Smash Game is a fast and chaotic physics game where you smash through floors, obstacles, and enemies to reach the bottom! Collect coins, dodge bullets, and upgrade your smash power, jump force, and trails.

Break enough floors to charge your smash meter and transform into an unstoppable bullet of destruction. How far can you smash?

title: Sniper Shot Secret Mission
description:
Sniper Shot Secret Mission is a game of nerves and skills. Each time you start the new level, a challenge is waiting for you to solve. Never fire on the wrong target otherwise their no second chance as a sniper. 
As a sniper you need to work silently once you shoot the bullet everyone will be aware of the situation and you might loose your target. You can be targeted through security guards once you shoot at your high profile targets.

title: Word Guess Game
description: Are you good at guessing a word from provided letters in random order? Here is a word-guessing puzzle game with arcade play rules. There are four different modes with more letters from four to seven. More difficult modes have more time for you to use. Keep calm and make a new reword!

title: Remove the Evidence
description: You’re not just solving puzzles—you’re covering your tracks! Step into the shoes of a hilariously clumsy criminal mastermind who always gets the job done but never without leaving a trail of chaos behind. Your mission? Clean up your mess before the authorities arrive!

title: Balloon Match 3D
description: Relax and enjoy this addictive ballons 3d matching game as you collect items and complete different missions.Your goal is to clear the bubble by finding and matching all ballons before the time runs out!

title: GTA: Grand Vegas Crime
description: Grand Vegas Crime is an open-world action game set in a sprawling city inspired by Las Vegas. Players take on the role of a daring gangster looking to rise through the criminal underworld. The game offers intense missions, thrilling car chases, and fierce shootouts against rival gangs and law enforcement. Grand Vegas Crime delivers an adrenaline-pumping experience filled with crime, action, and adventure.

title: Trash Flow
description: Trash Flow is a simple yet addictive game where you collect trash, earn points, and upgrade your abilities.Navigate your vacuum through a field of debris, managing your limited battery life while unlocking more powerful suction.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Pop Puzzle
description: Dive into the vibrant world of Pop Puzzle, a colorful block-busting challenge that tests your strategy and quick thinking. Tap on groups of matching blocks to clear the screen and progress through levels filled with satisfying chain reactions. Simple, addictive, and fun for players of all ages.

title: Royal Garden Match 2
description: Royal Garden Match 2 is here! Join Aria as she tends the kingdom’s most prestigious Royal Garden. Restore it to its former glory by completing fun match-3 puzzles! Match royal flowers, fruits, and plants across hundreds of levels packed with daily missions and challenges. Enjoy a magical journey full of beauty, strategy, and rewards. Play Royal Garden Match 2 now and bring the Royal Garden back to life!

title: Battle Arena Race to Win
description: Battle Arena Race to Win is a high-octane arena game where you join the Red or Blue team and engage in fierce car battles. Choose from a variety of cars, collect and upgrade them to dominate the arena. Balance speed, durability, and acceleration to outmaneuver opponents. Equip your car with strategic items, upgrade for success, and climb the leaderboard to lead your team to victory!

title: Ocean Pop
description: Ocean Pop is a lively underwater puzzle game where real 2D bubbles float, bounce, and cluster with natural physics. Pop matching bubbles, trigger chain reactions, and enjoy dynamic, ever-shifting puzzles. Its colorful ocean setting, smooth mechanics, and playful movement create a relaxing yet engaging experience that’s easy to learn and satisfying to master.

title: Hide & Seek Go And Find
description: Enjoy the classic game of Hide & Seek in a whole new way with 'Hide & Seek - Family Edition'! Play offline with up to five characters: mother, father, child, police, and thief, each with their unique role. Fathers seek their children, mothers search diligently, children hunt for hidden chocolates, police track down thieves, and thieves sneakily collect treasures.

title: Alchemy Puzzle
description:
We create challenges with fun puzzles, challenge your brain and make you always smile on your lips.
Alchemy Puzzle will help you have moments of light entertainment, combined with puzzle play and fun real life characters.
If you've ever played games: puzzlers, word games, trivia games, quiz games, brain teasers, or just want to spend time have time to relax, let try Alchemy Puzzle, It's for you.

title: Save Stranding Fish
description: Help all the little fish that unfortunately wash up on the beach to escape their predicament.You must pay attention to the order in which you rescue the fish.

title: My Little Car Wash
description: Wash and shine with My Little Car Wash, a 2D cartoon game that lets you clean different vehicles. You don’t need any experience, just follow the hints and use the tools to make the vehicles look new. You will have 22 vehicles to choose from, each with its dirt and stains. You will also have the drivers watching you as you work, so be quick and efficient. You will earn yellow stars for each vehicle you wash. My Little Car Wash is a game that will teach you some washing skills! Have fun!

title: ASMR Nail Treatment
description: Today's patient is dealing with thickening of the fingernails. Help her maintain good nail hygiene by providing proper nail care. Showcase your medical skills by performing this ASMR Nail Treatment game. Once the treatment is done, dress her in fashionable outfit and create captivating nail art using various styles and accessories.

title: Incredible Princesses and Villains Puzzle
description: A puzzle game for girls where the player has to collect puzzles with images of princesses and villains. The game features 50 tasks, the difficulty of which is gradually increasing. Each puzzle is unique, which contributes to the development of logical thinking, imagination and fine motor skills of the players. Let's start collecting puzzles and immerse ourselves in a world of magic and adventure with beautiful princesses and dangerous villains!

title: Air Block
description:
Jump, Place Blocks, and Conquer Challenging Levels!

In Air Block, use quick reflexes and smart block placement to overcome obstacles and enemies. With limited blocks per level, every move counts! Avoid saws, spikes, and unlock doors to progress—plus, grab those bananas if you can!

Game Modes:

Single Player – Test your skills across unique levels.
Two-Player Mode – Compete in quick place challenges and mini-games like Beach Ball, with more to come!
Think you’ve got what it takes? Start now!

title: Russian Derby Crash
description:
Russian Derby Crash is a thrilling game that immerses you in the atmosphere of spectacular car racing with elements of destruction. You'll control one of five Russian cars or a tank. Destroy cars on the training ground and unlock new ones!
This game has a unique twist: in addition to cars, there's a tank on the training ground, from which you can shoot at other participants!

title: Colossatron
description:
Take charge of a giant robotic snake and smash through cities with ease as you fight to create the most fearsome weapon of all time.
Unleash the power of Colossatron! A unique combination of Match 3 and Snake gameplay allows you to build a devastating machine by merging colored power ups to create new and more powerful weapons. With thousands of potential combinations, the key to victory lies in mastering the art of building Colossatron to take down formidable bosses.

title: Brain puzzles-Quests
description: This is the puzzle game filled with challenging, interesting tasks that will help you relax and have fun. There are games for training thinking, mental tasks, and IQ tests suitable for those who like to think. Develop logic, pump your brains!

title: Chess Online
description:
Options:
- Choose an opponent from 18 difficulty levels from Beginner to World Champion
- Selection of time control modes: Unlimited, Bullet, Blitz, Rapid, Classic
- Highlighting possible moves when choosing a piece
- Cancel the move, if there was a yawn, you can go back
- Interactive hints, showing the best move during the game
- Analysis after the game, highlights mistakes and gives recommendations on how to play
- Replay the game from the right place
- Setting the handicap

title: Shoot N Crush
description: Unleash your shooting skills and break bricks in Shoot N Crush. This game is the best choice for your leisure time. Your goal is to shoot with precision and flexibility. Use the bouncing ball to smash a solid brick with precision. Each level has a different objective and difficulty, you need to break these bricks in the smartest way possible.

title: Ping Pong Air
description: Table tennis, also known as ping pong, is an easy and enjoyable arcade game in which you control the bat as simply as in life: with the mouse or the movement of your finger. Several modes await you to suit every taste. In classic mode, you go through worlds, earn cups and unlock new opportunities. In Halloween mode, you have to banish spirits for a while, improving your reaction. In Career mode, you move up the tournament ladder, taking part in games against increasingly stronger opponents.

title: Real Parkour Simulator
description: Real Parkour Simulator is an addictive 3D parkour adventure game. You play as an ambitious protagonist determined to conquer the world of parkour. Taking you on an exciting journey to new heights as you run, jump and climb in an immersive world. Will you rise to the challenge and become a parkour master?

title: Super Soccer Noggins
description: Select your preferred nation and guide them to triumph in the wildest soccer competitions. Experience 10 unique powerups and numerous diverse fields, each adding a distinct, whimsical touch to every game. Can you conquer all 6 trophies in this exhilarating soccer adventure?

title: Guess Word
description: Guess Word is a free online puzzle and word game for boys played on PuzzleGame. It's easy to play. You have six chances to guess words. The letter you guessed will change color to give you a hint. This tests your vocabulary. The game is simple and very suitable for players of all ages. Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop are playable! We have three modes for you. Challenge yourself!

title: Powerwash Simulator - 3D Wash
description: There’s no stain too tough, no dirt too thick that you can’t handle. So gear up, point your washer, and get ready to bring the shine back to everything around you.

title: Cooking Festival
description: Cooking Festival is a delicious management sim that will let you bake, fry and grill around the world! Become the master chef the cooking world has been waiting for and whip up some homemade pancakes, grill juicy ribs, bake aromatic original Italian pizzas, and serve delicious ice cream that everyone loves!

title: Cyber Highway Escape
description: Experience the thrill of high-speed cyberpunk bike racing under the neon lights of a futuristic metropolis, as you weave your way through the winding streets and dodge obstacles in this adrenaline-fueled nocturnal adventure.

title: Dragon Island Idle 3d
description: Welcome to Dragon Island Idle 3D, a casual idle 3D world. Raise your dragons and build a wonderful island empire. Unlock all facilities to get income. For example, unlock a new pasture to raise more dinos. Unlock synths for the new area. Unlock the incubator to get dinos.

title: Treasure Hunt Puzzle
description: Explore ruins, complete stone tablet puzzles, and collect treasures! Solve each puzzle by fitting all your blocks into the board using the symbols as hints.

title: Sneaker Art
description: Sneaker Art is a creative casual art game where you become a pro sneaker designer. Grab your paintbrush, unleash your imagination, and craft unique shoe designs. Choose from a variety of laces, showcase your artwork, and sell your masterpieces in your sneaker shop. Pack your custom sneakers in stylish boxes and grow your business with every sale!

title: Fairyland Merge & Magic
description: Fairyland Merge & Magic is a puzzle casual merge game set on an enchanting island of imagination and wonder. Step into a vibrant mosaic of captivating stories, each intricately crafted with actual magical elements, where every move you make has the power to shape your own whimsical world.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Zombie Eeaster Bunnies
description: You are in abandoned village infested with zombie bunnies. You are there because you love the their delicious colored eggs. You need them, but the evil rabbits won't let you go away with them so easily. Kill or escape from the evil bunnies, collect us many easter eggs as you can and leave the village alive if you can. Use your powerful laser gun to destroy the evil rabbits and collect the ammunition scattered around the village. Watch your back! The Zombie Bunnies are silent and deadly!

title: Pet Salon Simulator
description: It's a very busy day at the pet salon! Jump in and give our furry friends the full treatment. Wash, groom, and style them to look even more charming and adorable. Show off your grooming skills and create picture-perfect transformations that will make every pet leave feeling proud and confident!

title: Scroll and Spot
description: Experience the joy of the holidays with Scroll and Spot, a unique Christmas-themed puzzle game! Explore two beautifully crafted images as you scroll to uncover five subtle differences hidden within.The scrolling feature keeps both images perfectly aligned, making it a dynamic and immersive puzzle experience. Challenge your observation skills and celebrate the holiday spirit with every discovery!

title: Super Cloner 3D
description: In Super Cloner 3D, you are a unique super cloner on a mission to infiltrate dangerous environments. Use your cloning powers to escape traps, kill enemies, and accomplish secret missions.

title: West Frontier Sharpshooter 3D
description: Have you ever dreamed of being a cowboy in a world like A Fistful of Dollars? Then this game is made for you! This is a Western-style sniper game, take your Winchester Model 1894 to kill all the bandits, and bring justice to this land!  Carefully plan the order of killing and don't let the covering fire kill you! Sometimes head-on confrontations are inevitable, all the bandits are firing, but you are ready for this, show them the power of your M1873!

title: Ultra Pixel Survive 2
description:
Command heroes with unique abilities, gather natural resources to produce materials, then build and develop your military defenses.
Enemy hordes will attack the village, challenging your strategic and tactical abilities to survive. Explore dark underground dungeons and battle against gigantic bosses!
Features
Build and upgrade your resources and heroes
Set up defenses, hunt, cook, and much more
Unlock new characters
Action RPG and survival gameplay
Beautiful epic fantasy pixel art

title: Fishing Fishes
description:
Fish some fishes in Fishing Fishes with your fishing fishers


You'll start with a basic fishing setup, you get fishes and you can use them to buy new fishers and other upgrades that will help you get even more fish!


With intuitive controls, Fishing Fishes is a perfect game for anyone who loves fishing or management games. So what are you waiting for?

title: Beat Music Battle
description: Step into the world of Beat Music Battle: 456 Survival, where rhythm meets creativity and fun! This casual music game is perfect for puzzle enthusiasts and party lovers alike.

title: Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem
description:
Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem is an exciting motorcycle racing game. 
In this game you will become a motorcycle racer who travels through city streets and highways, avoiding collisions with other vehicles. You will be able to unlock faster and more powerful motorcycles, each with its own unique handling characteristics, as well as improve the characteristics of your motorcycle. One of the key features of the game is a realistic physics engine that makes the gameplay challenging and exciting.

title: Enchanted Easter Adventure
description: Step into a magical springtime world in Enchanted Easter Adventure, where Lily and adorable bunny come together to celebrate Easter! This whimsical game combines storytelling, mini-puzzles, character dress-up, and holiday cheer in one unforgettable journey.

title: Organize It
description: Organize It is a decompression and organizing game for all players. Aren't you tired of all the clutter and chaos? Don't you just find peace when everything is in its right place and in harmony? Everything is scattered in total chaos. Only a hero can fight against all this chaos. This is your chance to organize it! Solve ingenious puzzles and organize everything to find harmony at every level. Organize, profit and become the best of the best!

title: Solitaire Klondike
description:
Step into the timeless challenge of Solitaire Klondike, an addictive HTML5 card game designed for fans of classic solitaire. Enjoy hours of relaxing gameplay with this popular version of Klondike Solitaire, where players arrange cards in descending order and alternate colors to win. If you need a fresh start, simply shuffle new cards to explore different winning strategies!
Perfect for anyone who loves solitaire,  Solitaire Klondike combines strategy, patience, and quick thinking.

title: Barrel Roller - Amazing Runner
description:
Collect and stack barrels, avoid obstacles, and make the highest barrel stack ever! 
Unlimited levels of stacking satisfaction!

title: Eating Simulator
description:
Eating Simulator is a funny clicker game.
?GROW BY EATING! ?
?LEVEL UP AND UPGRADE BY SELLING YOUR FOOD ?
?Can you become the most substantial of them all??

title: Dino Shooter Pro
description: Dino Shooter Pro is an exciting gun battle game. You are on an island. There are many dinosaurs and bad guys on this island. They are extremely ferocious and attack everyone they see. Your weapon is a gun. When there are dinosaurs and bad guys around you, pick up your gun, aim at the opponent, and fire bullets in rapid succession.  Try to kill all of them, good luck!

title: Back To School: Uniforms Edition
description: Explore global fashion in Back to School: Uniforms Edition! This fun dress-up game lets you spin the wheel to unlock school uniforms from countries like Japan, the U.S., the U.K., India, France, and South Korea. Customize your character with stylish outfits, accessories, and hairstyles inspired by each culture. Dive into the diversity of school uniforms and become a fashion expert while having fun!

title: Body Care Simulator
description: ASMR Cleaning is a fun simulation game on yad.com. There are four sections: foot spa, manicure, lip care, and clean inside the ear. You will enter a quiet and comfortable environment and experience different care processes. Have fun!

title: Stardom Alt-Girls Fashion Duel
description: Welcome to the world of daring alternative glamour! Meet two star heroines - Sydney and Sabrina. Help them go beyond the usual and try on the most daring alternative images: from a gentle soft-grunge princess to a gloomy rock diva. In the game, you can make bright makeup with arrows and sparkles; create unusual hairstyles; collect memorable outfits from tops, corsets, mini skirts and oversized jackets. Create your own collection of stunning Alt-girl looks!

title: Ragdoll Mega Dunk
description:
Welcome to the Ragdoll Mega Dunk indoor extreme basketball club! The game is a cool Ragdoll style basketball simulator .
Every attempt to do a trick will be unique! Throw the ball into the basket and fly there yourself!

title: Space Waves
description: Space Waves is an arcade game where you control an arrow through dozens of levels across multiple worlds and modes, dodging obstacles at every turn. Pick any level, any time, and let the difficulty faces guide how brave you're feeling.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Deadflip Frenzy
description:
Deadflip Frenzy is a wild stunt-flipping action game where chaos meets style! Launch your character into the air, pull off insane flips, twists, and bone-crunching landings — all in the name of fun (and maybe a little destruction).

Bounce off trampolines, launch from cannons, smash through obstacles, and aim for the most outrageous combos. The more insane your flip, the higher your score. But beware — one bad landing and it’s ragdoll mayhem!

title: Tiny Cars
description: Tiny Cars is a colorful arcade traffic management game where players must avoid collisions. With a top-down view and engaging gameplay, this game features 50 base stages set in various locations like crossroads, squares, and highways. After completing the initial 50 levels, players will encounter the same environments with increased difficulty, offering a challenging and addictive experience for traffic control enthusiasts. Enjoy managing the traffic and becoming a master of Tiny Cars, the ultimate arcade traffic management game!

title: We Will Not Survive
description: Survive the apocalypse in We Will Not Survive, an idle tower defense game! Upgrade weapons, harvest resources, and fight relentless zombie waves to protect your base. Are you ready to defend and thrive?

title: Creepy Dress Up
description: A spooky-fun game where you unleash your creativity by dressing up in eerie costumes. Choose from a wide range of creepy outfits, ghoulish makeup, and spooky accessories. Your mission? Scare the boys and have fun watching their reactions in this fun-filled, frightfully stylish game.

title: Wednesday Light Academia
description: Join the trend in Wednesday Light Academia - a fun, immersive makeover game for girls! Today you're becoming a super-talented stylist and your job is to transform Wednesday Addams from a dark e-girl look to a stunning girly-girl fashionista. Explore the fun realms of makeup, hairstyling, and fashion-forward wardrobe choices with this addictive game. Have fun!

title: Ellie and Friends Venice Carnival
description: Step into the glamorous world of Venice Carnival Dressup with Ellie and Friends Venice Carnival, where you can join Ellie and her friends at one of the most extravagant events of the year. The Venice Carnival is all about stunning masks, luxurious costumes, and endless glamour, and now you get to help Ellie and her friends get ready for the big celebration! Design unique looks and create the perfect carnival style with a variety of costumes, accessories, and masks.

title: Sort Master
description: Get ready to bring order to the chaos in Sort Master, a relaxing yet addictive online puzzle game. Test your logic and observation skills as you sort, match, and organize a variety of fun challenges — from colors to everyday objects. Whether you’re playing on your phone or computer, enjoy the satisfying feeling of tidying up and completing each level with perfection. Play for free and become the ultimate Sort Master!

title: Gym Muscle Merge Tycoon
description: Gym Muscle: Merge Tycoon is an addictive game where you create your team of fighters and transform them into real muscle heroes. Connect fighters to strengthen their muscle mass, improve their characteristics, and earn profit. Participate in fighting tournaments to compete for cool rewards and become the most powerful fighter of all time!

title: Sorting Sorcery
description:
All the pots, crystals, mushrooms and other magical ingredients have been mixed up! Brush up your organizing skills and sort the witches’ and wizards’ items in the magic castle.

The fewer moves you use, the higher your score per level will be. You can earn three stars in every level if you solve the puzzles efficiently, so plan your moves! Sorting Sorcery includes a total of fifty levels with witchy, spooky and magical ingredients to discover and organize.

description:
Tank Challenge is an action-packed tank battle game that tests your reflexes and strategy. Play solo or challenge a friend in fast-paced matches.

Defeat your opponent using powerful weapons like lasers, triple bullets, bomb shells, and rockets.

Make quick decisions, aim carefully, and stay ahead to win. Smooth on mobile and desktop, easy to learn but challenging to master.

Enter the arena and fight for victory!

We bring 3 BFFs, each with a unique style, many makeup options, stunning dresses, and accessories for your inspiration. This game is perfect for players who enjoy brain teasers and want to test their problem-solving skills.

Tic-Tac-Toe Merge is a revolutionary twist on the classic game! Unlike traditional tic-tac-toe, pieces have power levels from 1 to 3. Place higher-level pieces to capture your opponent's weaker ones!

MERGE TO DOMINATE
Combine two level-1 pieces to create level-2, and two level-2 to forge powerful level-3. Create chain reactions when 3+ same-level pieces align — they merge into an even stronger piece!

Start your cute cat adventure now!

Join Kids Supermarket to elevate your observation and categorization skills. Our diverse and clearly aligned products will make you feel like shopping in a real-life supermarket. Pick up your shopping basket and start your journey in the supermarket.

As the city crumbles under relentless attacks, you are tasked with surviving the brutal onslaught while rescuing survivors and taking down ruthless enemies. Navigate through abandoned streets, derelict buildings, and multi-floor complexes, each filled with challenges and surprises.

description: Step into a sweet little food studio and craft desserts for hungry customers! Follow simple step-by-step recipes, pick the right ingredients, and assemble tasty treats exactly as requested. Satisfy each guest to earn coins, then spend your rewards in the shop to unlock more items, upgrades, and delicious options. Easy to learn, relaxing to play, and full of colorful desserts!

Complete Daily Missions, tackle tricky blockers, and uncover hidden treasures. With stunning graphics and immersive gameplay, Magic & Wizards delivers a captivating experience filled with mystery. Ready for your magical adventure?

description:
Block 3D Puzzle is a colorful logic game where you need to place 3D blocks on the board in the right order. Every move turns into a bright visual effect — when you place a figure and complete a line, the entire line lights up with that block’s color!
Plan your moves carefully, fill the lines, and clear space for new blocks. The game combines relaxing gameplay, smooth animations, and stylish 3D graphics, making every puzzle a true visual delight.

As players progress, they must carefully plan their moves to create larger and larger tiles. With its simple yet addictive gameplay, 2048 Drop Merge is a must-play for fans of puzzle games looking for a fun and challenging experience. Have fun!

title: Paint Sponges Puzzle

It might seem straightforward, but don’t be fooled! Each level brings more complex mazes to test your problem-solving skills. Plan carefully, avoid traps, and complete all levels. Sharpen your mind and enjoy victories in this colorful adventure!

Reach the trophy at the end of the level to win, but it's not as easy as it might seem. You can't fall off the platforms; spikes and blades will be everywhere, making the levels more challenging. One wrong step and it's game over.
You'll need to stay calm, pay attention, be agile, have good reflexes, and most importantly, don't get angry.

Match colorful Sprunki characters across 100 hilarious levels filled with chaos, charm, and absurdity. Every move connects you with the bizarre Sprunki universe, where each character is weirder than the last. Get ready to swipe, match, and laugh your way through the most brainrotted garden ever!

Earn coins by killing zombies and use them to purchase new towers, upgrade existing ones, or sell for cash and reinvest into a different turret.

Defend your base from waves of shambling corpses as you fight to stay alive in a world gone mad.

Use realistic medical tools to diagnose, clean wounds, check heartbeats, and perform surgeries. Each level brings new challenges where you must care for sick, injured, or pregnant animals in a friendly hospital environment.

But there’s a catch—limited space on the board and only a few slots to move the cubes forward. You’ll need to plan ahead and choose the right cube to move first. Strategize carefully to avoid blocking yourself and clear the board to progress through each level!

title: Fortress of the Sinister
description: Fortress of Sinister is a thrilling 3D strategy game that blends tactical depth with exciting challenges. Take part in strategic turn-based battles on grid-based arenas, recruit unique units like the Mushroom Priest and Night Hunter, and unveil hidden secrets. In this immersive 3D game, your goal is simple: shoot as many bottles as you can. With limited time, precision, and speed are key to achieving the highest score. 

Tap or click to shoot the bottles. Shoot fast, shoot accurate to get the best score!

title: Match Fighter
description:
Match Fighter is a vibrant match-3 fighting game where classic martial arts meet puzzle action! Play as a skilled warrior and take on a series of powerful opponents. Match tiles to strike and unleash special moves in intense one-on-one duels. Every combo you make fuels your fighting spirit. Outsmart your enemies, climb the ranks, and prove yourself as the ultimate martial arts champion!

Can you match your way to victory?
